Q(1): السؤال: Q(3932): For ultrasound examination of salivary glands, which transducer frequency is optimal?
التفسير: Higher frequency yields better resolution for superficial glands.
شرح كامل: A 7.5 MHz linear probe balances penetration and spatial resolution, ideal for imaging superficial salivary tissues and ductal structures.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3933): A lead apron with 0.5 mm lead equivalent attenuates approximately what percentage of scatter at 100 kVp?
التفسير: Half-millimeter lead blocks most scattered photons.
شرح كامل: At 100 kVp, a 0.5 mm lead apron typically attenuates around 90% of scatter radiation, significantly reducing dose to radiosensitive organs.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3934): Which digital detector architecture generally exhibits the lowest fill factor?
التفسير: CMOS sensors have circuitry occupying pixel area.
شرح كامل: CMOS detectors integrate electronics at each pixel, reducing active photodiode area (fill factor) compared to CCD, affecting sensitivity and noise performance.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3935): The technique that uses two center-of-rotation points during panoramic acquisition to reduce distortion of anterior teeth is called what?
التفسير: This method shifts the rotation center to widen the focal trough for anterior structures.
شرح كامل: Double-center rotation adjusts pivot points during image capture, improving sharpness of anterior teeth by effectively broadening the focal trough region.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3936): Which hereditary condition presents with bilateral multilocular radiolucent jaw lesions best seen on panoramic radiographs?
التفسير: Cherubism causes bony expansion with multilocular radiolucencies.
شرح كامل: Cherubism manifests in childhood as bilateral jaw enlargement due to fibro-osseous lesions; panoramic imaging reveals characteristic “soap-bubble” radiolucencies.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3937): What is the recommended vertical angulation for standard posterior bitewing exposures?
التفسير: A slight upward tilt improves interproximal visualization.
شرح كامل: Using +10° vertical angulation aligns the beam through interproximal contacts, reducing overlap and optimizing detection of proximal caries.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3938): Which accessory device most effectively reduces scatter reaching the receptor in CBCT imaging?
التفسير: An anti-scatter grid absorbs obliquely scattered photons before they reach the detector.
شرح كامل: By placing a grid between the patient and detector, scatter radiation is preferentially absorbed, enhancing image contrast in cone-beam CT scans.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3939): In panoramic tomography, “section thickness” is primarily determined by which factor?
التفسير: Narrower slits produce thinner tomographic sections.
شرح كامل: Section (focal trough) thickness in tomographic imaging depends on the width of the tomographic slit aperture; adjusting slit width alters the depth of the focal plane.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3940): In digital imaging, the Nyquist frequency defines what characteristic of the system?
التفسير: The Nyquist frequency equals half the sampling rate, setting the resolution limit.
شرح كامل: Raster sampling frequency dictates that features finer than the Nyquist limit cannot be accurately represented, leading to aliasing if exceeded.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3941): Which radiographic technique uses tomosynthesis to produce sectional images at different depths?
التفسير: Digital tomosynthesis acquires multiple projection angles to reconstruct partial 3D slices.
شرح كامل: Digital tomosynthesis captures a series of tilted projections over a limited arc, reconstructing sectional images and reducing out-of-plane blur in a selected depth.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3942): Which post-processing method redistributes pixel intensities to enhance overall contrast?
التفسير: This algorithm spreads out the most frequent intensity values, improving global contrast.
شرح كامل: Image histograms are recalculated so that intensities cover the full range, revealing details in under- or overexposed regions.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3943): What is the ICRP’s annual occupational dose limit for the crystalline lens of the eye?
التفسير: Recent ICRP guidelines lowered the lens limit to 20 mSv/year to reduce cataract risk.
شرح كامل: Radiation protection standards now recommend a 20 mSv/year limit for the eye lens, down from previous 150 mSv, reflecting sensitivity to ionizing radiation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3944): Which modality is used in salivary gland function assessment by detecting radionuclide uptake and clearance?
التفسير: Scintigraphy visualizes gland function via gamma-camera imaging of tracer kinetics.
شرح كامل: Technetium-99m pertechnetate is injected intravenously, and serial images track uptake and excretion, aiding diagnosis of sialadenitis or obstructive pathology.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3945): A ghost image on a PSP plate digital radiograph typically results from what cause?
التفسير: Residual latent image persists when plates are not fully erased.
شرح كامل: If the plate isn’t sufficiently exposed to white light before reuse, residual electrons create a faint “ghost” of the previous image superimposed on the new exposure.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3946): A step wedge is routinely used in processor quality assurance to evaluate which parameter?
التفسير: Step wedges of varying thickness produce known density steps, testing contrast fidelity.
شرح كامل: By processing images of an aluminum or copper step wedge, one can assess the film-processing chemistry and development time by verifying consistent density differences between steps.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3947): What causes aliasing artifacts in digital radiography systems?
التفسير: Insufficient sampling frequency leads to misregistration of high-frequency detail.
شرح كامل: If the sampling rate falls below twice the highest spatial frequency, fine structures appear as Moiré or false patterns due to aliasing.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3948): Which extraoral view best demonstrates the floor of the maxillary sinus?
التفسير: The PA Waters projection tilts the head to profile the sinus floor unobstructed by the petrous ridge.
شرح كامل: Slight extension of the neck in Waters view projects the petrous ridge below the maxillary sinus floor, revealing sinus pathology or mucosal thickening.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3949): On a mandibular periapical film, how does the mylohyoid ridge typically appear?
التفسير: The mylohyoid ridge projects from the lingual cortex inferior to the mandibular canal.
شرح كامل: The mylohyoid ridge results from submandibular fossa anatomy and appears as a dense radiopaque line about 1 cm below the canal, often near molar roots.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3950): Which adjustment most improves signal-to-noise ratio in digital radiography?
التفسير: More photons per exposure increase signal relative to electronic noise.
شرح كامل: Boosting tube current raises the number of X-ray photons, raising detector signal and reducing the proportional impact of system noise.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3951): In film-screen systems, which factor most directly affects spatial resolution?
التفسير: Thinner emulsion layers resolve finer detail.
شرح كامل: Emulsion thickness determines granule size and light spread; thinner emulsions yield sharper images at the cost of slower speed.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3952): Which ultrasound artifact arises from multiple reflections between transducer and tissue interfaces?
التفسير: Multiple echoes produce equidistant artifacts.
شرح كامل: Reverberation artifacts appear as parallel lines or bands at regular intervals, often between transducer and bone surfaces, obscuring anatomy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3953): Which digital post-processing filter enhances the visibility of interfaces by accentuating intensity gradients?
التفسير: This filter multiplies pixel differences to sharpen borders.
شرح كامل: Edge enhancement algorithms highlight abrupt density changes, improving visualization of fine structural boundaries but potentially increasing noise.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3954): Which photoconductor material is used in direct conversion digital radiography detectors?
التفسير: A direct detector uses amorphous selenium (a-Se) to convert X-ray photons directly into electric charge.
شرح كامل: Amorphous selenium (a-Se) acts as a photoconductor in direct digital receptors, generating charge carriers upon X-ray absorption without intermediate light conversion, which enhances spatial resolution and minimizes scattering effects compared to indirect systems.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3955): Which parameter quantifies the efficiency of a detector in converting incident X-ray quanta into a useful image signal?
التفسير: DQE measures how effectively the detector converts radiation into image signal relative to noise.
شرح كامل: Detective quantum efficiency (DQE) is defined as the squared signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) at the detector output divided by the squared SNR at the input, reflecting detector performance in terms of dose efficiency and image quality.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3956): Which beam geometry does cone-beam computed tomography utilize?
التفسير: In CBCT, the X-ray source emits a cone-shaped beam that rotates around the patient to acquire volumetric data.
شرح كامل: Cone-beam geometry captures a volumetric dataset in a single rotation by projecting a broad cone of X-rays onto a flat-panel detector, enabling 3D reconstruction for dental and maxillofacial imaging with lower dose than MDCT.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3957): Which collimation shape most effectively reduces scatter radiation during intraoral exposures?
التفسير: Rectangular collimation limits beam size to the receptor area, reducing scatter.
شرح كامل: Rectangular collimation reduces the exposed area to match the receptor size, cutting scatter by approximately 60% compared to circular diaphragms and improving image contrast.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3958): Quantum noise in digital radiography primarily arises from what factor?
التفسير: Quantum noise is due to the random arrival of X-ray photons at the detector.
شرح كامل: Also called quantum mottle, this noise results from the Poisson distribution of photon detection; increasing mAs reduces quantum noise by raising the number of photons in the image.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3959): Photon-counting detectors in advanced CT systems uniquely provide which information for each detected photon?
التفسير: Photon-counting detectors measure individual photon energies, enabling spectral imaging.
شرح كامل: By registering the energy of each incident photon, photon-counting detectors facilitate material decomposition and improve contrast resolution, offering advantages over integrating detectors that only count total photons.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3960): Which artifact appears as concentric circular patterns centered on the rotation axis in tomographic images?
التفسير: Ring artifacts are caused by miscalibrated or defective detector elements.
شرح كامل: Ring artifacts manifest when one or more detector channels are insensitive or overresponsive, creating circular rings in reconstructed slices; calibration and detector maintenance are required to correct them.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3961): Partial volume effect in tomographic imaging refers to what phenomenon?
خيار 3: Averaging of different tissue densities within a voxel
الإجابة: Averaging of different tissue densities within a voxel
التفسير: Partial volume effect averages voxel contents when tissues of differing densities occupy the same voxel.
شرح كامل: In regions where small structures are smaller than the voxel size, the recorded attenuation is a weighted average, potentially obscuring fine details and affecting quantitative measurements.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3962): Which reconstruction algorithm reduces image noise by iteratively comparing measured and estimated projections?
التفسير: Iterative algorithms model physics and noise to improve image quality at lower dose.
شرح كامل: Iterative reconstruction refines the image through repeated forward and backward projections, minimizing discrepancies between measured and computed data, thus lowering noise and artifacts compared to FBP.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3963): A known limitation of CBCT compared to medical CT is which of the following?
التفسير: CBCT grayscale values are not standardized to HU, limiting quantitative assessments.
شرح كامل: CBCT systems lack proper beam hardening correction and calibration phantoms, resulting in variable gray values that do not correspond to standardized HU scales, limiting soft-tissue evaluation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3964): Which fat-suppression MRI sequence is particularly useful for detecting joint effusion and edema in the TMJ?
التفسير: Short TI inversion recovery (STIR) nulls fat signal and highlights fluid.
شرح كامل: STIR imaging uses an inversion pulse timed to suppress fat, providing high contrast for edematous or inflammatory changes in joint spaces without the need for contrast agents.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3965): A primary advantage of PSP plate digital detectors over conventional film is what?
التفسير: PSP plates capture a broad range of exposures before saturation.
شرح كامل: PSP (storage phosphor) plates exhibit a wide latitude, accommodating over- and underexposure with recoverable image data, reducing repeat rates compared to the narrow exposure latitude of film.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3966): For operator safety during X-ray exposure, at what angle relative to the primary beam should the operator stand?
التفسير: Standing at 90° to the beam path minimizes scatter exposure.
شرح كامل: Scatter intensity peaks in the forward and backward directions; positioning perpendicular to the central beam axis at least 2 meters away substantially reduces occupational dose.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3967): Which parameter most directly determines spatial resolution in flat-panel digital receptors?
التفسير: Spatial resolution is determined by the detector pixel pitch.
شرح كامل: Smaller pixel pitches allow finer detail capture; trade-offs include increased electronic noise and larger data volumes, requiring optimized detector design.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3968): The anode heel effect produces higher beam intensity on which side of the X-ray field?
التفسير: Beam intensity is greater on the cathode side due to the heel effect.
شرح كامل: In the heel effect, X-rays emitted toward the anode traverse more anode material and are attenuated more than those toward the cathode, resulting in intensity variation across the field.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3969): Which extraoral radiographic view best depicts the zygomatic arch without overlap?
التفسير: The SMV projection projects the arch above the mandible with minimal superimposition.
شرح كامل: In the submentovertex view, the central beam is directed below the mandible, highlighting the zygomatic arches and cranial base, commonly used for fracture evaluation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3970): Which radiographic projection is employed for transcranial assessment of the TMJ?
التفسير: The transcranial view images the condyle and joint space in oblique lateral projection.
شرح كامل: Taken with the beam angled 25–30° caudally to the horizontal plane, transcranial radiographs evaluate condylar position and joint space, aiding in detecting degenerative changes.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3971): At approximately 70 kVp in soft tissue, which photon interaction predominates?
التفسير: At higher kVp levels, Compton scattering dominates due to its weak energy dependence.
شرح كامل: Compton interactions scatter photons with reduced energy, degrading contrast; as kVp increases, the relative occurrence of Compton vs photoelectric shifts toward Compton.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3972): At lower kVp settings (~50 kVp) within bone structures, which interaction predominates?
التفسير: Lower-energy photons are more likely to be absorbed via the photoelectric effect in high-Z materials.
شرح كامل: Photoelectric absorption probability ∝ Z³/E³; therefore, in bone (higher Z), at lower energies, photoelectric effects dominate, enhancing bone-to-soft tissue contrast.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3973): A high kVp/low mAs exposure technique compared to low kVp/high mAs results in which change to image contrast?
التفسير: Raising kVp broadens the spectrum, reducing subject contrast.
شرح كامل: High kVp increases beam penetration and reduces differential absorption, yielding more shades of gray and lower contrast, often requiring software contrast enhancement.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3974): Film reticulation, characterized by a cracked emulsion appearance, is caused by which processing error?
التفسير: A rapid temperature shift causes emulsion expansion or contraction.
شرح كامل: Temperature fluctuations between developer and water baths induce cracking of the emulsion layer, manifesting as reticulation on processed films and reducing diagnostic value.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3975): Which historical contrast agent for sialography is known for prolonged retention within salivary ducts?
التفسير: Iodized oil is viscous and remains in ducts longer than water-soluble agents.
شرح كامل: Iodized oil (Lipiodol) provides strong radiopacity but requires extensive post-procedure lavage due to its oily nature and slow clearance, unlike modern agents like iohexol.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3976): Which extraoral view provides a true profile of the mandibular body?
التفسير: A lateral oblique projection images the mandible’s body without superimposition by the opposite side.
شرح كامل: By angling the beam posterior–anteriorly at 25° and positioning the mandible parallel to the receptor, the lateral oblique view separates the mandible from overlapping structures.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3977): Which occlusal radiographic technique best produces cross-sectional images of the anterior mandible?
التفسير: The cross-sectional occlusal view uses steep vertical angulation to slice through anterior mandible.
شرح كامل: With a vertical angulation of +65–70° for maxillary and −55–60° for mandibular cross-sectional occlusal images, this technique reveals buccolingual cortical plates and floor of mouth anatomy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3978): Which MRI sequence displays fluid with high signal and is most sensitive for pathology detection?
التفسير: T2-weighted images highlight fluid and pathology against darker background.
شرح كامل: T2-weighted sequences emphasize differences in water content, making edema, cysts, and inflammatory changes bright and easily identifiable in soft-tissue evaluation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3979): Which MRI artifact, often seen near metal restorations, appears as signal voids and geometric distortion?
التفسير: Metal alters local magnetic fields, causing signal dropout and distortion.
شرح كامل: Susceptibility artifacts arise from differences in magnetic susceptibility at tissue–metal interfaces, leading to phase dispersion and loss of signal around metallic dental materials.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3980): In panoramic imaging, if a patient’s anterior teeth appear narrowed and blurred, how were they positioned?
التفسير: Anterior positioning anterior to the focal trough compresses the image.
شرح كامل: When the dental arches lie in front of the focal trough, the image layer is too thin, causing narrowed, poorly defined anterior teeth on the panoramic radiograph.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3981): In panoramic imaging, if a patient’s anterior teeth appear widened and blurred, how were they positioned?
التفسير: Posterior positioning moves teeth behind the focal trough, enlarging and blurring them.
شرح كامل: Positioning the arches too far posterior to the focal trough increases object-film distance, magnifying and blurring the anterior teeth on the panorama.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3982): Which digital detector type generally exhibits the highest fill factor, resulting in greater sensitivity?
التفسير: CCD arrays have minimal circuitry per pixel, maximizing photodiode area.
شرح كامل: CCD (charge-coupled device) detectors dedicate most pixel area to photodiodes, yielding higher fill factors and improved detection efficiency compared to CMOS sensors.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3983): What is the optimal kVp setting for adult intraoral periapical radiography to balance contrast and patient dose?
التفسير: Sixty kVp provides adequate penetration with acceptable contrast.
شرح كامل: A standard adult periapical exam uses around 60 kVp at 7–8 mA to achieve sufficient beam quality for detail while keeping patient dose low.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3984): Which material is commonly used as a filtration filter to harden the X-ray beam in intraoral radiography?
التفسير: Aluminum filters remove low-energy photons, reducing patient dose.
شرح كامل: Aluminum sheets of 1.0–2.0 mm thickness filter soft X-rays, improving beam quality and reducing skin dose.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3985): What is the typical effective dose range for a small-FOV CBCT scan (5×5 cm)?
التفسير: Small-FOV CBCT doses are generally 50–100 μSv.
شرح كامل: Depending on voxel size and device, a 5×5 cm CBCT scan yields around 50–100 μSv, similar to several intraoral exposures.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3986): In CBCT calibration, a water phantom is used primarily to assess what parameter?
التفسير: Water phantoms test signal uniformity across the FOV.
شرح كامل: A uniform water-equivalent phantom yields constant attenuation, so any variation indicates nonuniform detector response or beam inhomogeneity.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3987): Which emerging technique analyzes textural patterns in radiographs to detect pathology?
التفسير: Radiomics extracts quantitative texture features for disease characterization.
شرح كامل: Radiomics algorithms compute metrics like entropy and homogeneity from imaging data, aiding in early detection of lesions.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3988): During digital detector quality assurance, the signal uniformity test measures what?
التفسير: Uniformity checks for consistent signal across the detector field.
شرح كامل: By analyzing a flat-field image, variations in mean pixel values reveal detector or beam nonuniformity requiring correction.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3989): Increasing kVp in intraoral radiography shifts the primary interaction from photoelectric effect toward what?
التفسير: Higher kVp increases photon energy, favoring Compton interactions.
شرح كامل: As beam energy rises, Compton scattering probability increases relative to photoelectric absorption, reducing subject contrast.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3990): Which CBCT artifact appears as streaks radiating from high-density objects?
التفسير: Dense objects cause localized attenuation leading to streaks.
شرح كامل: Metal restorations induce streak artifact due to extreme differential attenuation, requiring artifact reduction algorithms.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3991): A ghost image of the opposite TMJ is produced on a panoramic radiograph by which mechanism?
التفسير: Structures near the source cast secondary blurred images.
شرح كامل: Opposite TMJ mirrors due to X-rays passing through and reflecting off denser structures before reaching the film, creating a ghost.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3992): In DICOM calibration, the grayscale display function maps pixel values to luminance using which curve?
التفسير: Displays apply gamma correction to match monitor response.
شرح كامل: Gamma curves linearize monitor output, ensuring consistent gray-level representation of image data.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3993): What does exposure latitude refer to in radiography?
خيار 3: Range of exposures yielding acceptable contrast
الإجابة: Range of exposures yielding acceptable contrast
التفسير: Latitude defines exposure tolerance before image quality suffers.
شرح كامل: Wide latitude detectors or films maintain diagnostic quality over varying exposures, reducing retakes.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3994): Increasing pixel bit depth in digital radiography primarily improves what?
التفسير: More bits allow finer gray-scale differentiation.
شرح كامل: Higher bit depths (e.g., 14-bit vs. 8-bit) expand dynamic range, enabling detection of subtle tissue differences.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3995): Which phantom is used to calibrate Hounsfield units in CBCT scanners?
التفسير: The ACR CT phantom contains materials with known HU values for calibration.
شرح كامل: By scanning the ACR phantom containing water, air, and various density inserts, HU accuracy and uniformity can be verified.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3996): The beam quality index is most accurately represented by which measurement?
التفسير: HVL indicates beam penetrating ability.
شرح كامل: Measuring HVL in mm Al provides a standard for beam hardness and filter adequacy evaluations.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3997): When measuring the HVL, what is the absorber material commonly used?
التفسير: Aluminum is the standard filter material for HVL tests.
شرح كامل: Sequentially placing aluminum sheets and measuring intensities defines the thickness required to reduce beam to half its initial value.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3998): Which test assesses linearity of exposure vs. detector response in digital systems?
التفسير: Checks proportionality between dose and pixel values.
شرح كامل: Plotting pixel value versus known exposures reveals deviations from linear response, informing calibration.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(3999): The modulation transfer function at zero spatial frequency equals what?
التفسير: MTF(0) is unity representing perfect low-frequency transfer.
شرح كامل: MTF curves start at 1 (zero cycles/mm) and decline as spatial frequency increases, indicating contrast preservation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4000): Applying an anti-aliasing filter before sampling primarily prevents what in digital imaging?
التفسير: Low-pass filters remove high frequencies that cause aliasing.
شرح كامل: Pre-sampling optical filters blur frequencies above Nyquist, avoiding Moiré and false patterns.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4001): If the focal spot size doubles, what happens to penumbra width?
التفسير: Penumbra width is proportional to focal spot size.
شرح كامل: Unsharpness (penumbra) ∝ focal spot size × object–film distance / source–object distance; doubling focal spot doubles blurring.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4002): Geometric unsharpness (Ug) can be calculated using which formula?
خيار 2: Ug = focal spot size × object–film distance / focal spot-to-object distance
الإجابة: Ug = focal spot size × object–film distance / focal spot-to-object distance
التفسير: Unsharpness depends on focal spot size and geometry.
شرح كامل: Ug = (Focal spot size × Object-Film Distance) / Source-Object Distance quantifies geometric blur.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4003): Magnification factor in radiography equals which ratio?
التفسير: Magnification = SFD/SOD.
شرح كامل: M = Source-Film Distance / Source-Object Distance, indicating how much larger the image appears relative to the object.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4004): Panoramic images often have magnification around what percent?
التفسير: Panoramic units magnify 20–30% due to geometry.
شرح كامل: Panoramic magnification varies by manufacturer but typically lies between 20% and 30%, requiring dimensional corrections.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4005): The focal trough width is narrowest in which panoramic region?
التفسير: Anterior focal trough is narrowest, requiring precise positioning.
شرح كامل: Incisor region focal trough width is smallest (~4–6 mm), so slight misalignment blurs anterior teeth.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4006): Adding 0.5 mm copper filtration instead of 2.5 mm aluminum results in what dose effect?
التفسير: Copper more effectively filters low-energy photons per thickness than aluminum.
شرح كامل: Copper filters harden the beam more efficiently, reducing patient dose further compared to aluminum filters of equal thickness.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4007): Which filter combination yields the highest beam hardness?
التفسير: Copper has higher atomic number, producing harder beam.
شرح كامل: Copper filters increase average beam energy, reducing patient dose but may lower contrast.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4008): Excessive horizontal angulation error in bitewing radiography leads to what artifact?
التفسير: Incorrect horizontal angle merges tooth contacts.
شرح كامل: Horizontal misalignment causes proximal surfaces to overlap, obscuring interproximal caries.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4009): In panoramic radiography, rotating the patient’s head slightly forward affects the image how?
التفسير: Forward tilt moves teeth behind focal trough.
شرح كامل: Head forward position falls behind focal trough, widening and blurring anterior teeth.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4010): Which occlusal technique provides lateral cross-sectional views of the anterior maxilla?
التفسير: Cross-sectional occlusal uses steep vertical angulation for lateral views.
شرح كامل: A vertical angulation of +65–75° yields cross-sectional slices showing buccolingual anatomy of anterior maxilla.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4011): D localization of root canal anatomy in CBCT primarily uses which display mode?
التفسير: MPR allows simultaneous axial, coronal, and sagittal views.
شرح كامل: Multiplanar reconstruction displays cross-sections in three orthogonal planes, facilitating canal morphology assessment.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4012): Subtraction radiography is most useful for detecting small changes in what?
التفسير: Subtracting sequential images highlights density changes in bone.
شرح كامل: Digital subtraction removes unchanged structures, enhancing visibility of bone remodeling or caries progression.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4013): Wide dynamic range in digital receptors reduces the need for what?
التفسير: Wide dynamic range tolerates exposure variations without loss of detail.
شرح كامل: Plate-based detectors can capture diagnostic images over a broader exposure window, minimizing repeat exams.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4014): “Wrap-around” artifact in CBCT large FOV occurs due to what?
التفسير: FOV smaller than object leads to incomplete data and wrap-around.
شرح كامل: When anatomy extends beyond detector edges, projections wrap, causing circular streaks or distortions.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4015): Which method reduces scatter in CBCT without a grid?
التفسير: Bow-tie filters attenuate peripheral beam, reducing scatter.
شرح كامل: Bow-tie filtration shapes beam intensity, improving uniformity and lowering scatter in volumetric acquisitions.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4016): Iterative reconstruction algorithms improve image quality chiefly by reducing what?
التفسير: Iterative methods model noise and minimize it during reconstruction.
شرح كامل: By comparing measured and estimated projections, iterative reconstruction suppresses noise while preserving detail.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4017): Which MRI sequence eliminates chemical shift artifact?
التفسير: Dixon separates fat and water signals to reduce shift.
شرح كامل: Dixon techniques acquire in-phase and out-of-phase images, allowing separation and minimizing interface artifacts.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4018): Ultrasound elastography measures what property of tissue?
التفسير: Elastography quantifies tissue stiffness via shear wave velocity.
شرح كامل: By measuring displacement under stress, elastography distinguishes stiff versus compliant tissues, helpful in salivary gland pathology.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4019): Salivary gland scintigraphy commonly uses which radionuclide?
التفسير: Pertechnetate is concentrated by salivary tissue and reflects function.
شرح كامل: Dynamic imaging of Tc-99m pertechnetate uptake and clearance provides quantitative gland function assessment.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4020): Compared to thermoluminescent dosimeters, OSL dosimeters offer which advantage?
التفسير: OSL detects lower doses and retains signal until readout.
شرح كامل: OSL dosimeters using Al₂O₃:C material provide precise measurements at low doses with minimal drift.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4021): Dose–area product (DAP) reflects which parameter?
خيار 2: Total energy delivered independent of field size
الإجابة: Total energy delivered independent of field size
التفسير: DAP = dose × exposed area, indicating total radiation delivered.
شرح كامل: DAP measurements account for both exposure and field size, correlating with patient risk in radiographic exams.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4022): Misalignment of the collimator with the x-ray beam axis primarily affects what?
التفسير: Misalignment causes uneven radiation field edges and potential overexposure.
شرح كامل: If collimator blades aren’t perpendicular to the beam, the exposed area shifts, risking patient skin dose outside intended region.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4023): Pixel binning in digital detectors involves combining signals from adjacent pixels to improve what?
التفسير: Binning aggregates charge, raising signal relative to noise.
شرح كامل: By summing adjacent pixel data, binning enhances SNR at the expense of spatial detail.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4024): Which artifact is caused by sensor saturation from extremely high pixel values?
التفسير: Excess charge spills to adjacent pixels producing blooms.
شرح كامل: Blooming appears as bright halos or streaks around dense objects due to overfilled detector elements.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4025): When stitching multiple CBCT volumes for a large arch, misregistration manifests as what?
التفسير: Misaligned volumes create step-like discontinuities.
شرح كامل: Seam artifacts appear where two volume segments meet if patient movement or calibration differs between scans.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4026): A ghost image of a lead apron appears on panoramic radiographs due to what?
التفسير: Backscatter from apron material produces phantom images.
شرح كامل: Lead apron below chin can reflect scatter onto receptor, appearing as a faint silhouette above the actual apron location.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4027): Motion compensation software in CBCT corrects artifacts primarily by adjusting what?
التفسير: Software algorithms detect and correct misalignments during reconstruction.
شرح كامل: By tracking feature shifts across projections, motion-compensation modifies weighting to reduce blur.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4028): Excessive use of edge enhancement filters may cause what artifact?
التفسير: Over-enhanced edges produce halos around structures.
شرح كامل: Edge enhancement accentuates transitions but can generate bright or dark rings, misleading diagnosis.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4029): Biodosimetry in radiological incidents often uses what biological marker?
التفسير: Radiation induces DNA breaks detectable cytogenetically.
شرح كامل: Analysis of dicentric chromosome frequency in lymphocytes correlates with absorbed dose.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4030): Organ dose measurements in phantom studies typically utilize what device?
التفسير: TLDs placed in phantom cavities measure dose in specific organs.
شرح كامل: TLD chips embedded at organ sites record absorbed dose during imaging protocols for dose optimization.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4031): A parallel grid misalignment in film-screen systems produces what artifact?
التفسير: Misaligned grids absorb useful primary radiation at edges.
شرح كامل: When grid lines aren’t parallel to the beam, primary rays are attenuated disproportionately, causing density fall-off.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4032): Backscatter radiation from walls can increase operator exposure by reflecting what percent approximately?
التفسير: Scattered photons from surrounding surfaces contribute small additional dose.
شرح كامل: Studies show wall reflections can augment occupational exposure by about 5–10%, highlighting shielding importance.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4033): Radiant exposure (X) in radiography refers to which quantity?
التفسير: X is the energy delivered by radiation per unit area on a surface.
شرح كامل: Radiant exposure units of J/m² quantify incident energy, differing from dose (J/kg) which measures absorbed energy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4034): What advanced reconstruction technique in CBCT uses compressed sensing to reduce dose while maintaining image quality?
التفسير: Compressed sensing employs sparsity constraints to reconstruct from fewer projections.
شرح كامل: By leveraging the sparsity of dental anatomy in transform domains, compressed sensing algorithms solve underdetermined systems, enabling diagnostic images at reduced radiation doses.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4035): Which dual-energy CT application differentiates materials based on their energy-dependent attenuation?
التفسير: Dual-energy CT provides both material decomposition and virtual monoenergetic images.
شرح كامل: Virtual monochromatic reconstructions and material-specific maps exploit differences in attenuation at two energy spectra to enhance tissue characterization and reduce artifacts.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4036): In photon-counting CT, what primary benefit does energy discrimination of photons provide?
التفسير: Photon-counting detectors measure individual photon energies, enabling material-specific imaging.
شرح كامل: Spectral data allow for quantitative analysis of tissue composition, virtual non-contrast images, and better artifact suppression compared to conventional CT.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4037): Which artifact reduction algorithm specifically addresses metal artifacts in CBCT?
التفسير: Metal artifact reduction (MAR) interpolates missing projection data around metal.
شرح كامل: The MAR algorithm identifies metal traces in projections, interpolates over them, and reconstructs to minimize streaks, enhancing diagnostic value near restorations.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4038): What does the point spread function (PSF) of a radiographic system describe?
التفسير: PSF defines how a point object is imaged, determining system blurring.
شرح كامل: By measuring the PSF and its Fourier transform (MTF), one quantifies spatial resolution and evaluates imaging system performance.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4039): Which Monte Carlo simulation is most accurate for modeling photon interactions in dental CBCT?
التفسير: PENELOPE, GATE, and FLUKA all offer detailed MC modeling for X-ray transport.
شرح كامل: Monte Carlo codes simulate photon scatter, absorption, and secondary radiation, aiding in dose estimation and protocol optimization.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4040): In advanced MRI, what does the IDEAL sequence separate?
التفسير: IDEAL uses multiple echoes and phase shifts to distinguish fat from water.
شرح كامل: Four-point IDEAL acquisition yields separate fat-only, water-only, and combined images, improving lesion detection in soft tissues.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4041): Which algorithm addresses ring artifacts by correcting detector drift in CT?
التفسير: Combining normalization, temporal, and frequency filtering corrects ring artifacts.
شرح كامل: Ring correction workflows normalize detector responses, subtract temporal drift, and apply Fourier-based filters to suppress circular artifacts.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4042): What parameter does the contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR) measure?
خيار 1: Difference in signal divided by noise
الإجابة: Difference in signal divided by noise
التفسير: CNR quantifies the detectability of structures relative to background noise.
شرح كامل: Image quality assessments use CNR to optimize protocols balancing resolution and dose.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4043): Which deterministic effect threshold is most relevant for the lens of the eye in head CT protocols?
التفسير: Lens opacities occur above approximately 0.5 Gy in head imaging.
شرح كامل: Radiation-induced cataracts develop at thresholds around half a Gray; awareness informs shielding and protocol design.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4044): What is the main advantage of deep learning–based denoising in CBCT images?
التفسير: AI denoising reduces noise while maintaining edges better than traditional filters.
شرح كامل: Convolutional neural networks trained on paired noisy and ground-truth images learn to suppress noise adaptively, improving diagnostic clarity.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4045): Which measure quantifies the beam’s half-value layer reproducibility?
خيار 1: Standard deviation of HVL over time
الإجابة: Standard deviation of HVL over time
التفسير: Reproducibility assesses HVL variation across repeated measurements.
شرح كامل: QA protocols track HVL at intervals to ensure consistent beam quality and filtration integrity.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4046): In stereotactic radiosurgery planning, what imaging modality provides submillimeter accuracy?
التفسير: High-resolution gradient-echo MRI delineates soft tissues with submillimeter precision.
شرح كامل: Stereotactic targets rely on 3D MRI sequences like FGRE or SPACE for accurate delineation in radiosurgery workflows.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4047): Which dosimetric quantity integrates dose over a volume and area, correlating with stochastic risk?
التفسير: DLP sums CTDIvol over scan length, indicating total exposure.
شرح كامل: DLP estimates energy imparted and stochastic risk in CT by multiplying CTDIvol by scanned length.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4048): What is the advantage of using an anthropomorphic phantom over a uniform phantom?
التفسير: Anthropomorphic phantoms mimic human tissue heterogeneity and geometry.
شرح كامل: Phantoms with bone, soft tissue, air cavities allow realistic dose and image quality testing under clinical conditions.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4049): Which metric assesses temporal resolution in dynamic imaging?
التفسير: Higher fps improves capture of rapid physiological changes.
شرح كامل: Dynamic modalities (e.g., fluoroscopy, cine CBCT) require high frame rates to track motion without blur.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4050): In multi-slice CT, what does z-axis interpolation improve?
التفسير: Interpolation reconstructs thinner slices from helical data for isotropic voxels.
شرح كامل: Z-interpolation algorithms reduce partial volume artifacts and enable multiplanar reformats with equal resolution.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4051): Which advanced CT parameter directly affects the beam’s z-axis penumbra?
التفسير: Detector pitch defines helical overlap and z-penumbra extent.
شرح كامل: Pitch >1 reduces dose and increases penumbra; pitch <1 improves longitudinal resolution but raises dose.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4052): What benefit does iterative metal artifact reduction (iMAR) provide in head CT?
التفسير: iMAR diminishes streaks, enhancing tissue contrast near metal.
شرح كامل: By modeling beam hardening and scatter around implants, iMAR reconstructs clearer images without significantly altering scan parameters.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4053): Which dual-source CT advantage enables high temporal resolution?
التفسير: Dual-source CT uses two tubes/detectors at 90°, halving rotation time requirement.
شرح كامل: Shorter effective rotation time reduces motion artifacts in cardiac and TMJ imaging.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4054): What is the significance of the modulation transfer function at the Nyquist frequency?
التفسير: MTF at Nyquist is zero due to sampling limit.
شرح كامل: Beyond Nyquist, aliasing prevents accurate reproduction of higher frequencies, making MTF drop to zero.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4055): Which advanced scanning protocol in CT uses prospectively ECG-triggered acquisition?
التفسير: Prospective gating acquires data only at predefined cardiac phases, reducing dose.
شرح كامل: By synchronizing exposures to R–R intervals, prospective gating minimizes radiation while capturing specific heart cycle images.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4056): What does the detective quantum efficiency (DQE) curve describe across spatial frequencies?
التفسير: DQE(f) = (SNR_out/SNR_in)^2 as a function of frequency.
شرح كامل: DQE curves reveal detector efficiency decline at higher frequencies, guiding system selection for specific clinical tasks.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4057): Which advanced artifact appears in CBCT when using high tube current with rapid rotation?
التفسير: Rapid rotation with high mA introduces periodic streaks resembling windmill blades.
شرح كامل: Mechanical vibration at high rotation speeds couples with high photon flux, creating repetitive streak patterns.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4058): In radiotherapy planning CT, what advantage does a high-resolution mode provide?
التفسير: Thinner slices capture more anatomical detail for precise targeting.
شرح كامل: Higher resolution protocols use smaller detector collimation and overlap to improve delineation of treatment volumes.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4059): Which parameter in PET/CT quantifies metabolic activity per voxel normalized by injected dose?
التفسير: SUV = tissue activity concentration / (injected dose/body weight).
شرح كامل: PET SUVs allow comparison of tracer uptake across patients and scans for oncology and salivary gland studies.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4060): What does the term “quantum mottle” refer to in radiographic images?
التفسير: Quantum mottle arises from statistical variation in photon detection.
شرح كامل: Low photon counts lead to visible noise granularity, mitigated by higher mAs or advanced denoising.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4061): Which iterative reconstruction method explicitly models system optics and physics?
التفسير: Model-based IR includes system blur, noise, and geometry in the forward model.
شرح كامل: By simulating detector response, focal spot blur, and scatter, model-based IR achieves superior image quality at lower doses than statistical-only methods.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4062): In advanced fluoroscopy, which mode reduces cumulative dose by using pulsed acquisition?
التفسير: Pulsed mode generates bursts of X-rays synchronized to frame rate.
شرح كامل: By emitting radiation only during image capture intervals, pulsed fluoroscopy lowers patient exposure while maintaining temporal resolution.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4063): What capability does spectral photon-counting CT add to conventional CT?
التفسير: Material decomposition
رابط الصورة: Spectral CT differentiates materials using energy-resolved photon counts.
شرح كامل: dental_radiology_q190
العمود 11: Spectral photon-counting CT yields monochromatic images, virtual non-contrast scans, and quantitative material maps from a single acquisition.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4064): Which CBCT display mode allows reconstruction along any arbitrary curved plane?
التفسير: Oblique MPR reconstructs images along non-orthogonal or curved planes, facilitating analysis of curved anatomy.
شرح كامل: Oblique MPR enables visualization of structures like the mandibular canal in its entire course, by realigning slices to follow anatomical curvature, improving diagnostic accuracy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4065): What is the purpose of a digital tomosynthesis acquisition in dental imaging?
التفسير: Tomosynthesis reconstructs slices from a limited sweep of projections without full 360° rotation.
شرح كامل: Digital tomosynthesis acquires multiple low-dose projections over an arc and reconstructs sectional images, reducing out-of-plane blur for localized regions like implant sites.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4066): Which DICOM object stores structured measurements and annotations in radiology?
التفسير: DICOM Structured Reporting encapsulates measurements, annotations, and observations in XML-like format.
شرح كامل: DICOM SR documents clinical findings, ROI measurements, and structured text, enabling interoperability of quantitative data between PACS and reporting systems.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4067): In virtual implant planning, which CBCT-derived dataset is essential?
التفسير: Segmentation data define bone and soft-tissue volumes for guide design.
شرح كامل: DICOM SEG objects store segmented regions (e.g., mandibular canal, bone) extracted from CBCT, critical for accurate implant guide fabrication and surgical planning.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4068): Which MRI sequence is most sensitive to early bone marrow edema adjacent to cystic lesions?
التفسير: STIR suppresses fat signal, highlighting fluid and edema as high signal.
شرح كامل: STIR (Short TI Inversion Recovery) nulls fat to accentuate fluid-rich edema, making it the sequence of choice for detecting marrow changes around cysts or inflammation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4069): Photon starvation artifact in CBCT appears as what?
التفسير: Insufficient photons through dense areas cause streaking artifacts.
شرح كامل: Photon starvation occurs where the beam is highly attenuated (e.g., metal posts), leading to insufficient signal and dark streaks or noise bands in reconstructed slices.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4070): Which parameter does organ-based tube current modulation adjust to reduce dose?
التفسير: It varies tube current as the tube rotates around radiosensitive organs.
شرح كامل: Organ-based modulation lowers mA when the tube passes anteriorly (toward eyes or thyroid) and increases it posteriorly, reducing dose to sensitive tissues without affecting image quality significantly.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4071): What is the role of a bow-tie filter in cone-beam CT?
التفسير: Bow-tie filters attenuate peripheral beam more, equalizing patient dose and detector exposure.
شرح كامل: Bow-tie filters shape the X-ray beam profile, attenuating edges to compensate for thinner anatomy and reducing scatter, improving uniformity and reducing patient dose.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4072): Which artifact is introduced by miscalibrated detector gain in flat-panel systems?
التفسير: Variations in gain across detector rows or columns produce linear stripe artifacts.
شرح كامل: Stripe artifacts arise when certain detector elements output consistently higher or lower values, creating noticeable banding that can obscure diagnostic details.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4073): In CBCT voxel size reduction, which trade-off must be considered?
التفسير: Smaller voxels capture fewer photons per voxel, raising image noise.
شرح كامل: While smaller voxels improve spatial resolution, each receives less radiation, so photon statistics worsen and image noise increases, often requiring higher dose or advanced denoising.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4074): What is the advantage of using an anthropomorphic phantom over a uniform phantom in QA?
التفسير: Anthropomorphic phantoms mimic heterogeneous tissues and bone structures for realistic testing.
شرح كامل: Phantoms with bone- and soft-tissue–equivalent materials in anatomically accurate geometry allow end-to-end testing of protocols for dose and image quality in clinical-like scenarios.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4075): Which reconstruction algorithm reduces both noise and metal artifacts in CBCT?
التفسير: Model-based IR incorporates physics and artifact models to suppress noise and metal streaks.
شرح كامل: Model-based iterative reconstruction iteratively refines images using models of beam physics, scatter, and detector response, enabling substantial noise and artifact reduction compared to traditional methods.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4076): Dual-energy CBCT most directly enables which application?
التفسير: Dual-energy acquisitions allow reconstruction at different virtual energies to reduce beam-hardening artifacts.
شرح كامل: Dual-energy CBCT separates high- and low-energy data, allowing virtual monoenergetic reconstructions that minimize artifacts and improve contrast differentiation between materials.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4077): In MRI of the TMJ, which coil provides the best signal-to-noise ratio?
التفسير: Surface coils positioned close to the joint yield highest SNR.
شرح كامل: Ear or dedicated TMJ coils lie directly over the joint, maximizing signal capture and enabling high-resolution imaging of joint structures.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4078): Which gradient warp correction addresses geometric distortion in MRI?
التفسير: Nonlinearities in gradient fields warp images; correction algorithms remap pixels to true positions.
شرح كامل: Gradient calibration data is used to correct spatial distortions, ensuring accurate measurement and localization, critical for fusion with CT data in surgical planning.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4079): What is the main benefit of navigation-guided CBCT implant placement?
التفسير: Image guidance aligns surgical tools with preoperative CBCT data for precise implant placement.
شرح كامل: Navigation systems use CBCT-derived 3D models to track instruments in real time, enhancing accuracy and reducing surgical complications compared to freehand techniques.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4080): Which metric quantifies spatial resolution in digital radiography by measuring contrast at specified line pairs per millimeter?
التفسير: The modulation transfer function at a given spatial frequency reflects resolution capability.
شرح كامل: MTF curves plot system contrast response across frequencies; the frequency at which MTF drops to 10% is often quoted as limiting resolution.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4081): In sialography, which imaging modality uses contrast-enhanced CBCT to visualize ducts?
التفسير: CBCT after ductal injection provides high-detail 3D duct maps.
شرح كامل: Cone-beam sialography combines radiopaque contrast medium injection into salivary ducts with CBCT acquisition, yielding volumetric images of ductal anatomy for obstruction evaluation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4082): What is the effect of beam hardening correction algorithms on CBCT images?
التفسير: Beam-hardening correction compensates for energy-dependent attenuation to minimize streaks.
شرح كامل: Algorithms apply polynomial or physics-based models to adjust reconstructed voxel values, reducing cupping and streak artifact around dense structures.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4083): Which advanced visualization technique renders 3D surfaces with realistic lighting?
التفسير: SSD applies shading models to 3D surfaces for lifelike appearance.
شرح كامل: Shaded surface display extracts object surfaces at threshold values and uses light models (Phong) to apply shading, enhancing depth perception in surgical guides.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4084): Photon-counting detectors most improve which CBCT parameter?
التفسير: Photon-counting distinguishes photon energies, enabling spectral imaging.
شرح كامل: Spectral histograms from each voxel allow material decomposition and virtual non-contrast images, advancing diagnostic capabilities beyond conventional CBCT.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4085): In digital panoramic QA, which test object verifies focal trough accuracy?
التفسير: A wire or bead array placed at known positions tests focal trough alignment.
شرح كامل: Beads positioned at specific depths are imaged to verify that only those within the focal trough appear sharp, ensuring accurate patient positioning guidance.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4086): What is the principle of pixel pitch reduction for improving detector performance?
التفسير: Reducing pixel size increases spatial sampling density.
شرح كامل: Detectors with finer pixel pitch capture more detail but require high signal-to-noise designs to maintain image quality at low exposures.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4087): Which artifact arises from misregistration of dual-energy CBCT projections?
التفسير: Inconsistent projection alignment between energy datasets creates ghosting.
شرح كامل: Differences in patient motion or geometry between low- and high-energy acquisitions produce misaligned images, leading to ghost shadows in material-specific reconstructions.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4088): What is the benefit of using DWI (diffusion-weighted imaging) in head and neck MRI?
التفسير: DWI reflects water mobility, relating to tissue cellularity and pathology.
شرح كامل: DWI highlights areas of restricted diffusion (e.g., tumors or cysts) as high signal, aiding in lesion characterization and therapy response monitoring.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4089): Dose–length product (DLP) in CT correlates with which risk assessment metric?
التفسير: DLP multiplied by conversion factors estimates effective dose.
شرح كامل: DLP represents cumulative dose over scan length; using region-specific k-factors converts DLP to estimated effective dose for cancer risk assessment.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4090): Which forensics technique uses panoramic radiographs for age estimation?
التفسير: Panoramic images show developmental stage of teeth for age estimation.
شرح كامل: In children and adolescents, eruption sequence and root maturation stages on panoramic images are compared to standards (Demirjian) for forensic age determination.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4091): In ultrasound imaging of the TMJ, Doppler mode assesses what?
التفسير: Color or power Doppler visualizes blood flow in synovium.
شرح كامل: Doppler ultrasound measures synovial perfusion, indicating inflammation or synovitis in TMJ disorders, complementing structural gray-scale imaging.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4092): Which digital subtraction method accentuates bone healing changes?
التفسير: Subtracting baseline and follow-up images reveals subtle bone density changes.
شرح كامل: Temporal subtraction aligns and subtracts sequential radiographs, highlighting incremental bone remodeling or lesion resolution.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4093): What is the main advantage of using a 2D/3D fusion navigation system?
خيار 3: Integration of CBCT with optical tracking
الإجابة: Integration of CBCT with optical tracking
التفسير: Fuses preoperative CBCT 3D data with live video or optical tracking for guided interventions.
شرح كامل: Optical trackers register patient anatomy to CBCT volume, overlaying instrument position on 3D models, enhancing precision in biopsies or implant surgery.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4094): Which advanced algorithm segments cortical bone from CBCT volumes automatically?
التفسير: U-nets learn complex features to differentiate cortical bone from other tissues.
شرح كامل: Machine learning models trained on labeled datasets accurately segment cortical and cancellous bone in CBCT, facilitating automated analysis and surgical guide design.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4095): In panoramic imaging, what occurs if the patient’s Frankfurt plane is tilted upward?
التفسير: Upward tilt (chin down) produces a convex occlusal plane curve (“frown”).
شرح كامل: Incorrect head flexion changes the occlusal plane orientation: chin-down (<–> frankfurt plane low) yields downward curvature resembling a frown.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4096): Which method measures detector detective quantum efficiency (DQE) across frequencies?
التفسير: Analyzing edge response yields DQE via MTF and noise power spectrum.
شرح كامل: The slanted-edge method acquires an image of a sharp edge at a slight angle, enabling extraction of MTF and noise power spectral density to compute DQE.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4097): Which acoustic phenomenon limits ultrasound resolution at tissue interfaces?
التفسير: Reflection and refraction at interfaces degrade beam and resolution.
شرح كامل: Mismatches in acoustic impedance between tissues cause echo and energy loss, reducing penetration and resolution at boundaries (e.g., bone–soft tissue).

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4098): What is the effect of using a higher frame averaging factor in digital fluoroscopy?
التفسير: Averaging multiple frames lowers random noise at expense of temporal resolution.
شرح كامل: Temporal averaging filters fluctuations by combining successive frames, improving image quality but potentially introducing lag or ghosting with motion.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4099): Which advanced CBCT QA test evaluates geometric accuracy of 3D measurements?
التفسير: Measures known distances in phantom to verify dimensional fidelity.
شرح كامل: Phantoms with embedded spheres or rods at precise distances are scanned to assess and calibrate geometric accuracy for surgical guide production.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4100): What is the role of the image receptor’s dynamic range in digital radiography?
خيار 1: Number of gray shades it can represent
الإجابة: Number of gray shades it can represent
التفسير: Wider dynamic range records more gray levels between darkest and brightest.
شرح كامل: Dynamic range determines exposure latitude; receptors with high bit depth capture fine contrast differences even in over- or underexposed regions.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4101): In CBCT-guided endodontics, which tool uses CBCT data to guide file insertion?
التفسير: GPS-like systems track handpiece in real time using CBCT reference.
شرح كامل: Dynamic navigation integrates CBCT volume with optical tracking of instruments, enabling precise canal access and minimal tissue removal during endodontic procedures.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4102): Which MRI parameter reflects tissue T2 relaxation properties?
التفسير: TE influences T2-weighted contrast by timing signal acquisition when transverse magnetization decays.
شرح كامل: Selecting long TE values accentuates T2 differences between fluids and solid tissues, useful for detecting edema or cystic lesions.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4103): What artifact arises from off-center patient positioning in CT?
التفسير: Off-center placement alters HU calibration, causing inaccurate densities.
شرح كامل: Misalignment relative to isocenter changes path length and calibration factors, leading to systematic HU shifts that affect quantitative assessments.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4104): Which Q-factor metric evaluates ultrasound transducer performance?
التفسير: Q-factor = center frequency / bandwidth, indicating selectivity and resolution.
شرح كامل: Higher Q-factors (narrow bandwidth) yield better axial resolution but lower penetration; transducer design balances both.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4105): In dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI, what does the wash-in rate indicate?
التفسير: Rapid wash-in reflects high perfusion or leaky vessels in pathology.
شرح كامل: Kinetic curves of contrast uptake reveal parameters like K^trans, reflecting tissue vascularity and capillary permeability, important in tumor characterization.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4106): Which test object is used to assess noise power spectrum in digital radiography?
التفسير: Uniform field images are analyzed to derive noise spatial frequency content.
شرح كامل: Analyzing a flat-field image with uniform intensity yields noise power distribution across frequencies, informing filter design and protocol optimization.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4107): What is the advantage of a 16-bit display workstation over 8-bit for radiographs?
التفسير: 16-bit displays represent 65,536 gray levels versus 256 levels in 8-bit.
شرح كامل: Fine gradations in density are crucial for subtle findings; high-bit displays and GPUs maintain perceptual contrast for diagnostic accuracy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4108): Which calibration routine corrects for image lag in panel detectors?
التفسير: Accounts for residual charge from previous exposures affecting subsequent frames.
شرح كامل: Image lag algorithms subtract a fraction of previous frame signal to eliminate ghosting and ensure temporal fidelity in dynamic studies.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4109): What documentation standard ensures traceability of digital image edits?
التفسير: Logs all modifications with timestamps and operator IDs.
شرح كامل: DICOM Correction Log modules record the history of image annotations, presentations, and corrections, satisfying medico-legal and QA requirements.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4110): Which legal regulation governs patient radiograph retention in the US?
التفسير: HIPAA mandates secure storage and retention policies for medical records, including images.
شرح كامل: HIPAA requires that patient records be kept for minimum periods defined by state law, with secure access controls to protect privacy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4111): What is the principal risk of repeated panoramic retakes?
التفسير: Multiple exposures increase stochastic risk, especially of thyroid and eye lens.
شرح كامل: Retakes compound radiation exposure; strict QA and positioning training minimize repeats to adhere to ALARA principles.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4112): Which standard defines DICOM metadata for radiation dose tracking?
التفسير: RDSR objects encapsulate dose metrics from modalities for PACS integration.
شرح كامل: DICOM RDSR modules store CTDIvol, DLP, fluoroscopy times, and fundamental parameters, enabling dose monitoring and patient dose registry.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4113): What best practice ensures long-term digital image archive integrity?
التفسير: Redundant arrays and geographic backups prevent loss from hardware failure or disaster.
شرح كامل: Implementing RAID mirrored storage, regular checksum verification, and off-site/cloud replication ensures DICOM archive resilience and compliance with retention policies.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4115): Which fiber group of the periodontal ligament primarily resists vertical masticatory forces?
التفسير: Oblique fibers are the most abundant PDL fibers and are oriented to resist vertical masticatory forces by transmitting them to the alveolar bone.
شرح كامل: Oblique fibers run diagonally from the cementum to the bone and play a critical role in absorbing vertical occlusal forces during mastication, preventing damage to the root and bone.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4116): The critical probing depth is defined as the depth beyond which further scaling and root planing will result in what outcome?
خيار 4: Reduced pocket depth without attachment loss
التفسير: Critical probing depth indicates that beyond this depth, scaling and root planing may cause attachment loss rather than gain.
شرح كامل: The critical probing depth is typically around 2-3 mm; treatment below this depth is beneficial, but deeper pockets require careful evaluation to avoid damage to tissues.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4117): Which cytokine is most implicated as a key mediator in alveolar bone resorption in periodontitis?
التفسير: IL-1 beta is a potent pro-inflammatory cytokine promoting osteoclast activation leading to alveolar bone resorption in periodontitis.
شرح كامل: IL-1 beta induces the expression of RANKL which stimulates osteoclast differentiation and activation, resulting in bone loss characteristic of periodontitis.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4118): In aggressive periodontitis, which microorganism is most commonly associated?
التفسير: Aa is strongly linked with localized aggressive periodontitis, particularly in young patients.
شرح كامل: Aggregatibacter actinomycetemcomitans produces leukotoxins that impair neutrophil function, leading to rapid periodontal destruction.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4119): What is the ideal angle of root planing stroke relative to the root surface?
التفسير: The ideal root planing stroke angle is approximately 60 degrees to the root surface for effective calculus removal without excessive root damage.
شرح كامل: A 60-degree angle allows the curette blade to engage calculus deposits efficiently while minimizing damage to cementum and dentin.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4120): Which radiographic feature is characteristic of vertical bone defects?
خيار 1: Horizontal bone loss parallel to CEJ
خيار 2: Triangular radiolucency along the root surface
الإجابة: Triangular radiolucency along the root surface
التفسير: Vertical defects show angular bone loss resulting in a radiolucent triangular shape adjacent to the root.
شرح كامل: Vertical defects involve uneven bone loss, forming an angular crater, often amenable to regenerative therapy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4121): What is the main advantage of guided tissue regeneration (GTR) in periodontal therapy?
التفسير: GTR uses barrier membranes to prevent the fast-growing epithelium from filling the defect, allowing slower bone and ligament cells to regenerate.
شرح كامل: By excluding epithelial and connective tissue cells, GTR facilitates selective repopulation of periodontal ligament and bone cells for true periodontal regeneration.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4122): Which drug is most commonly associated with drug-induced gingival hyperplasia?
التفسير: Phenytoin, an anti-epileptic drug, commonly causes gingival enlargement in susceptible patients.
شرح كامل: Phenytoin stimulates fibroblast proliferation and extracellular matrix production, leading to gingival overgrowth mostly affecting anterior gingiva.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4123): The biologic width in healthy periodontium averages approximately?
التفسير: Biologic width is approximately 2 mm, consisting of junctional epithelium and connective tissue attachment.
شرح كامل: Maintaining biologic width during restorative procedures is critical to prevent chronic inflammation and attachment loss.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4124): Which clinical feature differentiates necrotizing ulcerative gingivitis (NUG) from chronic plaque-induced gingivitis?
التفسير: NUG presents with necrosis and characteristic cratered papillae along with pain and fetid breath.
شرح كامل: NUG is an acute condition caused by spirochetes and fusiform bacteria, often in immunocompromised or stressed patients.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4125): In periodontitis, alveolar bone loss is primarily due to activation of which cells?
التفسير: Osteoclasts resorb alveolar bone in response to inflammatory mediators during periodontitis.
شرح كامل: Cytokines like RANKL activate osteoclasts, causing bone destruction in periodontal disease.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4126): Which is the most effective clinical method to detect furcation involvement?
التفسير: The Nabers probe is specifically designed to detect furcation entrance and involvement.
شرح كامل: Furcation involvement often cannot be fully assessed radiographically; tactile clinical probing remains gold standard.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4127): What is the earliest histologic feature of gingivitis?
التفسير: Early inflammation shows vascular dilation and increased permeability leading to edema.
شرح كامل: This increased vascular response causes redness and swelling characteristic of initial gingivitis.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4128): Which of the following periodontal pathogens is considered a “keystone pathogen” due to its ability to manipulate host immune response disproportionately?
التفسير: P. gingivalis modulates host response, promoting dysbiosis despite its low abundance.
شرح كامل: It alters complement pathways and neutrophil functions, enabling pathogenic biofilm survival.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4129): What is the main purpose of a gingivectomy?
خيار 1: Reduce pocket depth by removing alveolar bone
خيار 2: Reshape gingiva to improve access and reduce pocket depth
الإجابة: Reshape gingiva to improve access and reduce pocket depth
التفسير: Gingivectomy removes excess gingival tissue to eliminate pockets and improve plaque control.
شرح كامل: It is mainly indicated in cases with gingival enlargement or pseudo-pockets without bone loss.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4130): Which local factor contributes most to the initiation of periodontitis?
التفسير: Bacterial plaque initiates host inflammatory response leading to periodontitis.
شرح كامل: Calculus is a secondary factor that facilitates plaque retention but is not directly pathogenic.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4131): Which of the following is a risk indicator but not a risk factor for periodontitis?
التفسير: Stress correlates with periodontitis but does not directly cause it.
شرح كامل: Risk factors are causal; risk indicators are associated but causality is uncertain.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4132): The main mechanism of action of tetracycline in periodontal therapy is?
التفسير: Tetracycline inhibits matrix metalloproteinases, reducing connective tissue breakdown.
شرح كامل: This property makes it beneficial as adjunctive therapy to reduce tissue destruction.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4133): What is the clinical significance of junctional epithelium in periodontal disease?
خيار 1: It is a physical barrier preventing bacterial invasion
خيار 2: It facilitates rapid epithelial migration to cover wounds
خيار 3: It attaches gingiva firmly to alveolar bone
خيار 4: It is a source of inflammatory cells
الإجابة: It is a physical barrier preventing bacterial invasion
التفسير: Junctional epithelium seals the gingival sulcus, limiting bacterial penetration.
شرح كامل: Loss or detachment of junctional epithelium allows periodontal pathogens to invade deeper tissues.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4134): Which of the following periodontal surgical procedures is indicated primarily for esthetic root coverage?
التفسير: Gingival grafts (free or connective tissue) are used to cover exposed roots and improve esthetics.
شرح كامل: This procedure also reduces sensitivity and prevents further recession.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4135): Which immunoglobulin class predominates in gingival crevicular fluid during periodontitis?
التفسير: IgG is the main antibody found in GCF and plays a role in immune defense against periodontal pathogens.
شرح كامل: High IgG levels correlate with host response to chronic infection in periodontal tissues.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4136): In furcation classification, a Class III involvement indicates?
خيار 1: Incipient involvement with early bone loss
خيار 2: Partial bone loss with partial furcation exposure
التفسير: Class III furcation indicates a through-and-through bone defect in multi-rooted teeth.
شرح كامل: This severely compromises tooth prognosis and complicates treatment.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4137): Which clinical parameter is the most reliable indicator of active periodontal disease?
التفسير: Bleeding on probing reflects current inflammation and active disease sites.
شرح كامل: Probing depth can be deep due to past disease; BOP indicates ongoing inflammation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4138): What is the role of RANKL in periodontitis?
التفسير: RANKL binds to RANK on osteoclast precursors to promote osteoclastogenesis and bone resorption.
شرح كامل: Overexpression of RANKL in periodontitis leads to pathological alveolar bone loss.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4139): Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of necrotizing ulcerative periodontitis (NUP)?
التفسير: NUP is painful with necrosis and rapid attachment loss, swelling is usually painful.
شرح كامل: NUP occurs mostly in immunocompromised patients with systemic symptoms.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4140): What is the best radiographic method to assess early interdental bone loss?
التفسير: Bitewings provide the best view of crestal bone levels between posterior teeth.
شرح كامل: Panoramic radiographs have lower resolution for early bone changes.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4141): Which periodontal ligament fiber group is most involved in resisting lateral tooth movement?
التفسير: Horizontal fibers run perpendicular to the root surface and resist lateral forces.
شرح كامل: These fibers stabilize the tooth against forces that push it sideways.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4142): What is the primary purpose of a mucogingival surgery?
التفسير: Mucogingival surgery aims to increase the width of keratinized attached gingiva for periodontal health.
شرح كامل: Adequate attached gingiva resists mechanical trauma and inflammation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4143): Which of the following bacteria is NOT part of the “red complex” in periodontitis?
التفسير: S. mutans is associated with caries, not periodontal disease.
شرح كامل: The “red complex” bacteria are highly pathogenic in periodontitis.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4144): In periodontitis, what does a furcation involvement indicate about disease progression?
خيار 2: Advanced bone loss around multirooted teeth
الإجابة: Advanced bone loss around multirooted teeth
التفسير: Furcation involvement shows that bone loss has progressed to the root branching area, complicating treatment.
شرح كامل: It significantly reduces tooth prognosis and may require surgical intervention.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4145): Which of the following systemic diseases has the strongest association with periodontitis?
التفسير: Diabetes is strongly linked to increased risk and severity of periodontitis.
شرح كامل: Poor glycemic control worsens periodontal inflammation and impairs healing.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4146): What is the primary mechanism of bone loss in periodontitis?
التفسير: Inflammatory cytokines stimulate osteoclastogenesis leading to bone resorption.
شرح كامل: This process results in progressive alveolar bone loss typical of periodontitis.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4147): Which clinical procedure best assesses the depth and morphology of a periodontal pocket?
خيار 3: Periodontal probing with a calibrated probe
الإجابة: Periodontal probing with a calibrated probe
