شرح كامل: Around 5-25% of leukoplakias exhibit epithelial dysplasia on biopsy, indicating malignant potential warranting surveillance or excision.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4408): Normal range of stimulated salivary flow rate is?
التفسير: Saliva increases substantially on stimulation.
شرح كامل: Stimulated flow rises with mastication or gustatory stimuli; values under 0.7 mL/min indicate hyposalivation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4409): How long does the latency period of oral squamous cell carcinoma typically last before clinical signs appear?
التفسير: Long latency due to multistep carcinogenesis.
شرح كامل: Carcinogenesis is gradual involving genetic and environmental factors, often requiring years before lesion becomes clinically evident.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4410): The percentage of oral candidiasis cases caused by Candida albicans is approximately?
التفسير: C. albicans is the predominant species.
شرح كامل: Candida albicans is the most common fungal pathogen in oral candidiasis, accounting for the vast majority of cases.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4411): In oral pemphigoid, the blister forms at what histological level?
التفسير: Pemphigoid shows subepithelial blistering.
شرح كامل: Pemphigoid causes separation at the basement membrane, forming subepithelial blisters, differentiating it from intraepithelial blistering seen in pemphigus.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4412): Which systemic medication is most associated with oral lichenoid reactions?
التفسير: Many antihypertensives cause lichenoid lesions.
شرح كامل: Beta-blockers and other medications can induce lichenoid mucosal reactions resembling lichen planus clinically and histologically, requiring drug history assessment.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4413): Average size of a benign oral fibroma is usually?
التفسير: Most fibromas are small nodules less than 1.5 cm.
شرح كامل: Oral fibromas are reactive hyperplasias usually small and painless, resulting from chronic irritation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4414): The prevalence of angular cheilitis in denture wearers is about?
التفسير: Common in poorly fitting dentures causing fungal/bacterial infection.
شرح كامل: Angular cheilitis is frequent in denture wearers due to saliva pooling and fungal colonization, presenting as painful fissures at mouth corners.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4415): The most sensitive test for detecting oral squamous cell carcinoma invasion depth is?
التفسير: MRI provides excellent soft tissue contrast for invasion depth.
شرح كامل: MRI evaluates soft tissue extent and depth of tumor invasion crucial for staging and surgical planning in oral cancer.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4416): The minimal daily dose of radiation causing oral mucositis during cancer therapy is?
التفسير: Mucositis commonly develops after cumulative doses above 20 Gy.
شرح كامل: Radiation-induced mucositis starts appearing as erythema and ulcerations typically after 20 Gy cumulative dose, significantly impacting quality of life.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4417): What is the normal thickness of the parotid gland duct (Stensen’s duct)?
التفسير: Typical duct diameter ranges between 1.5-3 mm.
شرح كامل: Knowledge of duct anatomy aids in diagnosis and surgical interventions related to sialolithiasis or duct injuries.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4418): Which measurement defines microdontia of teeth?
خيار 1: Teeth less than 2 SD below average size
الإجابة: Teeth less than 2 SD below average size
التفسير: Microdontia refers to teeth significantly smaller than population mean.
شرح كامل: Microdontia is a developmental anomaly with teeth smaller than average by more than two standard deviations, often affecting maxillary lateral incisors or third molars.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4419): In oral tuberculosis, typical granulomas measure how much in diameter?
التفسير: Granulomas range 200-300 micrometers.
شرح كامل: Tuberculous granulomas are compact collections of epithelioid histiocytes and giant cells of this approximate size, surrounded by lymphocytes and fibrosis.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4420): Average eruption age of permanent first molars is?
التفسير: First permanent molars erupt typically around age 6-7.
شرح كامل: Knowing eruption timing helps assess developmental anomalies or systemic diseases affecting teeth.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4421): The mean size of oral mucosal melanotic macules is usually?
التفسير: Most melanotic macules are small, less than 1 cm.
شرح كامل: These benign focal pigmentation spots rarely exceed 1 cm in diameter and require differentiation from melanoma.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4422): The mean life expectancy of untreated oral squamous cell carcinoma is?
التفسير: Untreated cases have poor prognosis with median survival less than 1 year.
شرح كامل: Early detection and treatment improve survival; untreated lesions progress rapidly causing local and systemic spread.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4423): Which vesiculobullous disease shows intraepithelial blistering with positive Nikolsky’s sign?
التفسير: Pemphigus vulgaris causes intraepithelial acantholysis, leading to fragile blisters and positive Nikolsky’s sign on mucosa.
شرح كامل: Autoantibodies target desmoglein-3 disrupting epithelial adhesion. This leads to painful erosions and ulcers requiring systemic corticosteroids and immunosuppressants.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4424): The most common form of oral candidiasis in healthy individuals is?
التفسير: White removable plaques characterize pseudomembranous candidiasis, often related to antibiotic or corticosteroid use.
شرح كامل: Candidiasis arises when local or systemic factors disrupt normal flora. Pseudomembranous form is acute and common in denture wearers, infants, or immunocompetent with risk factors.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4425): What is the hallmark oral lesion of HIV infection caused by Epstein-Barr virus?
التفسير: Presents as white corrugated plaques on the lateral tongue in immunocompromised patients.
شرح كامل: OHL is a clinical indicator of immunosuppression and reactivation of EBV. It is benign but indicates need for HIV evaluation and management.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4426): Which salivary gland tumor is notorious for perineural invasion and pain?
التفسير: Slow growing but infiltrates nerves causing pain and facial palsy.
شرح كامل: Requires aggressive treatment due to high recurrence; characterized histologically by cribriform (“Swiss cheese”) pattern and nerve invasion.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4427): Brown pigmentation of oral mucosa is characteristic of which systemic condition?
التفسير: Diffuse mucosal pigmentation due to increased melanocyte stimulating hormone.
شرح كامل: Pigmentation in Addison’s results from adrenal insufficiency and ACTH overproduction stimulating melanocytes; oral findings may precede systemic symptoms.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4428): Necrotizing ulcerative gingivitis is primarily caused by which bacteria?
التفسير: Spirochetes and fusiform bacteria cause rapid necrosis of gingival tissues.
شرح كامل: NUG is acute, painful with punched out papillae and fetid breath. Early treatment with debridement and antibiotics is essential to prevent progression.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4429): Oral squamous papilloma is mostly caused by which HPV types?
التفسير: Low-risk HPV types cause benign papillomas.
شرح كامل: These lesions are exophytic, papillary and usually asymptomatic. HPV vaccination reduces risk of related oral lesions.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4430): Wickham’s striae are diagnostic of which condition?
التفسير: Characteristic lace-like white lines on oral mucosa.
شرح كامل: Histopathology shows basal cell degeneration and band-like lymphocytic infiltrate; management includes corticosteroids.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4431): Glossitis with angular stomatitis usually indicates deficiency of?
التفسير: Deficiency causes mucosal atrophy and fissuring at mouth corners.
شرح كامل: Vitamin B12 is essential for DNA synthesis; deficiency manifests orally and hematologically; treatment is vitamin supplementation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4432): The most common site of oral squamous cell carcinoma is?
التفسير: High exposure to carcinogens and mechanical trauma.
شرح كامل: SCC arises from malignant transformation of epithelium; risk factors include tobacco, alcohol, HPV; prognosis depends on early detection.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4433): What confirms diagnosis of pemphigus vulgaris?
التفسير: Detects intercellular IgG deposits in epithelium.
شرح كامل: DIF is gold standard showing antibodies against desmogleins; essential for differentiating pemphigus from other bullous diseases.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4434): Sjögren’s syndrome mainly affects which glands?
التفسير: Autoimmune destruction leads to dry mouth and eyes.
شرح كامل: Chronic autoimmune disorder with lymphocytic infiltration causing gland dysfunction; diagnosis requires clinical and serological criteria.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4435): Histologically, oral lichen planus shows?
خيار 1: Saw-tooth rete ridges with lymphocytic band
الإجابة: Saw-tooth rete ridges with lymphocytic band
التفسير: Characteristic basal cell degeneration and dense subepithelial lymphocytes.
شرح كامل: Key for diagnosis and differentiates from lichenoid reactions and other white lesions.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4436): Which drug commonly causes gingival enlargement?
التفسير: Antiepileptic inducing fibroblast proliferation.
شرح كامل: Drug-induced overgrowth complicates plaque control; management includes hygiene and drug substitution.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4437): The most common cause of xerostomia?
التفسير: Glandular damage from radiation causes dry mouth.
شرح كامل: Radiation destroys salivary gland tissue; xerostomia increases risk of caries and mucosal infections.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4438): “Cotton wool” jaw radiograph is typical of?
التفسير: Patchy sclerotic lesions due to abnormal bone remodeling.
شرح كامل: Radiographic appearance with clinical bone deformities and elevated alkaline phosphatase.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4439): Persistent non-healing ulcer in smoker’s lateral tongue suggests?
التفسير: High malignancy risk requiring biopsy.
شرح كامل: Early biopsy essential for diagnosis; tobacco is major risk factor.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4440): Definitive test for oral hairy leukoplakia?
التفسير: Detects Epstein-Barr virus DNA in lesion.
شرح كامل: OHL caused by EBV reactivation in immunocompromised hosts.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4441): Normal unstimulated salivary flow is?
التفسير: Basal saliva secretion maintains oral health.
شرح كامل: Hyposalivation below 0.1 mL/min causes xerostomia.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4442): Typical radiographic feature of ameloblastoma?
التفسير: Classic radiographic pattern in posterior mandible.
شرح كامل: Benign odontogenic tumor with locally aggressive behavior requiring surgical excision.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4443): Most common site for oral squamous papilloma?
التفسير: HPV-induced exophytic lesion.
شرح كامل: Usually small painless papillary growths caused by HPV types 6 and 11.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4444): Lateral border of the tongue is the most common site of?
التفسير: Highest incidence of oral cancer.
شرح كامل: Tobacco and alcohol increase risk; early detection vital.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4445): Physiologic oral pigmentation is usually?
التفسير: Normal pigmentation in darker-skinned individuals.
شرح كامل: Differentiates from pathologic pigmentation requiring biopsy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4446): Vitamin C deficiency causes?
التفسير: Impairs collagen synthesis leading to fragile capillaries.
شرح كامل: Early recognition prevents systemic complications and tissue breakdown.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4447): Normal thickness of oral epithelium?
التفسير: Thin epithelial layer compared to skin.
شرح كامل: Thickness varies by site and keratinization status; important for permeability and healing.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4448): Corticosteroid dose for pemphigus vulgaris?
التفسير: High dose required for immune suppression.
شرح كامل: Early aggressive therapy controls autoantibody production and blister formation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4449): Minimal erythema dose in phototherapy for oral lichen planus?
التفسير: Starting dose to minimize adverse effects.
شرح كامل: UV therapy modulates inflammation with controlled dosing.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4450): Oral leukoplakia malignant transformation rate is approximately?
التفسير: Low but clinically significant risk.
شرح كامل: Requires surveillance and possible excision.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4451): Average latency from oral HPV infection to cancer?
التفسير: Long incubation before malignancy.
شرح كامل: Highlights importance of long-term follow-up.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4452): Normal stimulated salivary flow rate?
التفسير: Increases with mastication or gustation.
شرح كامل: Maintains oral homeostasis and digestion.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4453): A 45-year-old male presents with painful, widespread erosive lesions on buccal mucosa with Wickham’s striae. Biopsy shows band-like lymphocytic infiltrate. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Classic presentation with characteristic histology confirms OLP.
شرح كامل: OLP is an autoimmune chronic inflammatory condition causing white reticular patterns (Wickham’s striae) and erosions. Management involves topical steroids and monitoring for malignant transformation risk.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4454): A 30-year-old female with dry mouth, dry eyes, positive anti-Ro antibodies, and bilateral parotid enlargement. Most likely diagnosis?
التفسير: Autoimmune exocrinopathy involving salivary and lacrimal glands.
شرح كامل: Characteristic symptoms with positive serology and glandular swelling confirm diagnosis; management focuses on symptomatic relief and systemic immunomodulation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4455): A patient develops painful oral ulcers preceded by target skin lesions following herpes simplex infection. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Acute immune-mediated mucocutaneous disorder with characteristic target lesions.
شرح كامل: EM major often triggered by infections (HSV), involves oral mucosa and skin; treatment includes corticosteroids and supportive care.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4456): A 60-year-old smoker presents with a non-healing indurated ulcer on the lateral tongue for 3 months. Next step?
التفسير: Suspicious lesion for malignancy requiring histopathologic diagnosis.
شرح كامل: Early biopsy of suspicious ulcers essential to rule out squamous cell carcinoma; delay worsens prognosis.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4457): A 50-year-old patient has bilateral parotid swelling, dry mouth, and xerophthalmia but negative autoantibodies. Next best diagnostic step?
التفسير: Gold standard to confirm Sjögren’s syndrome despite seronegative status.
شرح كامل: Histopathology shows focal lymphocytic sialadenitis; helps confirm diagnosis in seronegative patients.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4458): A 55-year-old woman with gingival pain and desquamation, histology reveals subepithelial blister and linear IgG deposits along basement membrane. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Autoimmune subepithelial blistering disorder with scarring tendency.
شرح كامل: DIF shows linear IgG and C3 at basement membrane; treatment involves corticosteroids and immunosuppressants to prevent fibrosis and blindness.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4459): A 25-year-old presents with painful white plaques on lateral tongue that cannot be scraped off, biopsy shows epithelial hyperplasia without dysplasia. Diagnosis?
التفسير: EBV-associated lesion in immunocompromised patients.
شرح كامل: OHL presents as corrugated white patches on lateral tongue; associated with HIV; diagnosis confirmed by EBV detection.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4460): A 40-year-old diabetic complains of burning tongue and dry mouth, examination shows smooth erythematous tongue without plaques. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Vitamin B deficiency or candidiasis associated mucosal atrophy causing burning sensation.
شرح كامل: Atrophic glossitis shows loss of filiform papillae; burning sensation requires nutritional and infection evaluation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4461): A 70-year-old man with history of radiation therapy presents with bone exposure and pain in mandible. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Radiation-induced avascular bone necrosis following therapy.
شرح كامل: ONJ occurs due to compromised blood supply post-radiation; conservative management includes antibiotics and hyperbaric oxygen.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4462): A patient presents with rapidly enlarging painless mass in parotid gland with facial nerve weakness. Most probable diagnosis?
التفسير: Malignant tumor with perineural invasion causing nerve palsy.
شرح كامل: Aggressive behavior requires surgery and radiotherapy; nerve involvement worsens prognosis.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4463): A 35-year-old has recurrent angular cheilitis with erythema and fissuring at mouth corners. Most common cause?
التفسير: Opportunistic fungal infection due to saliva pooling.
شرح كامل: Angular cheilitis results from Candida or mixed infections, especially in denture wearers; antifungals and correction of contributing factors required.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4464): A patient reports burning sensation and altered taste with no visible mucosal changes. Most likely diagnosis?
التفسير: Idiopathic neuropathic pain disorder mostly affecting middle-aged women.
شرح كامل: BMS diagnosis of exclusion; management includes counseling, topical and systemic agents targeting neuropathic pain.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4465): A child presents with multiple oral ulcers preceded by fever and vesicles on hands and feet. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Coxsackie virus infection with characteristic distribution.
شرح كامل: HFMD causes vesicles on oral mucosa, palms, and soles, mostly self-limited; supportive care is mainstay.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4466): A patient presents with persistent painless white plaque on buccal mucosa that cannot be scraped off. Next step?
التفسير: Rule out dysplasia or malignancy.
شرح كامل: Leukoplakia requires biopsy to exclude premalignant or malignant changes; management depends on histology.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4467): A patient develops sudden onset painful ulcers with hemorrhagic crusting on lips after drug ingestion. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Severe mucocutaneous hypersensitivity reaction involving oral mucosa.
شرح كامل: SJS presents with extensive mucosal ulceration and systemic symptoms; urgent withdrawal of causative drug and supportive care required.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4468): A patient presents with recurrent oral ulcers preceded by prodromal symptoms and no systemic illness. Most probable diagnosis?
التفسير: Idiopathic recurrent painful ulcers affecting non-keratinized mucosa.
شرح كامل: RAS is a diagnosis of exclusion; topical corticosteroids reduce pain and duration; etiology includes immune dysregulation and trauma.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4469): A patient presents with asymptomatic white plaques on buccal mucosa that disappear on stretching. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Benign mucosal variation common in smokers and dark-skinned individuals.
شرح كامل: Leukoedema disappears on stretching; no treatment needed; differentiates from pathological white lesions.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4470): A patient has painful, well-demarcated, erythematous patches on the tongue with loss of filiform papillae. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Benign inflammatory condition with migratory depapillation.
شرح كامل: GT is characterized by erythematous areas with white borders changing location; usually asymptomatic but can cause burning.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4471): A patient presents with firm, painless swelling on the hard palate with central ulceration and rolled borders. Most likely diagnosis?
التفسير: Classic malignant lesion requiring biopsy.
شرح كامل: Ulcerated, indurated lesions are suspicious for SCC; early biopsy essential for diagnosis and treatment.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4472): A patient on phenytoin therapy presents with gingival enlargement. Best management?
خيار 1: Improve oral hygiene and consider drug substitution
الإجابة: Improve oral hygiene and consider drug substitution
التفسير: Control plaque and adjust medication if possible.
شرح كامل: Drug-induced gingival overgrowth is exacerbated by plaque; good hygiene plus changing causative drug reduces severity; surgery for persistent cases.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4473): A patient with a history of tobacco use presents with erythroplakia. Biopsy shows severe dysplasia. Management?
التفسير: High risk lesion requiring removal.
شرح كامل: Erythroplakia has high malignant potential; severe dysplasia mandates excision and close follow-up.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4474): A patient has unilateral parotid swelling and pain exacerbated by meals. Most likely cause?
التفسير: Stone obstructing salivary duct causing pain and swelling during salivation.
شرح كامل: Salivary stones block duct causing gland enlargement, pain; diagnosis via imaging; management includes removal of stone or surgery.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4475): A 50-year-old diabetic patient presents with painful oral thrush and burning sensation. Most appropriate treatment?
التفسير: Candida infection requires antifungal agents.
شرح كامل: Diabetes predisposes to candidiasis; topical antifungals such as nystatin or clotrimazole effectively treat oral thrush.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4476): A patient presents with painful ulcerative stomatitis following initiation of new medication. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Hypersensitivity reaction to medication causing mucosal ulceration.
شرح كامل: Drug-induced mucosal lesions require identifying and discontinuing offending agent; supportive therapy alleviates symptoms.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4477): A child presents with “strawberry tongue” and oral mucosal erythema. Which disease?
التفسير: Characteristic tongue appearance in streptococcal infection.
شرح كامل: Scarlet fever causes strawberry tongue with systemic symptoms; penicillin is treatment of choice.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4478): A patient presents with a painless, slow-growing swelling in the floor of mouth, bluish in color. Most likely diagnosis?
التفسير: Mucous extravasation cyst in the floor of mouth.
شرح كامل: Ranula is a retention cyst of sublingual gland; surgical excision required to prevent recurrence.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4479): A patient presents with burning sensation and erythematous mucosa with no clinical ulceration. Biopsy is normal. Most probable diagnosis?
التفسير: Idiopathic neuropathic pain without visible lesions.
شرح كامل: Diagnosis of exclusion; management includes counseling and neuropathic agents; no overt mucosal changes seen.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4480): A patient complains of facial pain triggered by touch over the cheek. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Paroxysmal lancinating facial pain in trigeminal nerve distribution.
شرح كامل: TN caused by vascular compression of nerve root; carbamazepine is first-line treatment.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4481): A patient with multiple painful oral ulcers and genital lesions likely has?
التفسير: Multisystem inflammatory disorder with mucocutaneous ulcers.
شرح كامل: Diagnosis based on recurrent oral/genital ulcers and ocular inflammation; immunosuppressive therapy required.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4482): A 65-year-old man presents with a painless pigmented patch on the palate that is enlarging rapidly. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Aggressive malignancy requiring urgent biopsy.
شرح كامل: Oral melanoma is rare but deadly; early detection crucial; biopsy confirms diagnosis and guides therapy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4483): A 52-year-old woman presents with painful oral erosions and skin blisters. Histopathology shows intraepithelial clefting and acantholysis. Which antibody is most commonly involved?
التفسير: Pemphigus vulgaris is characterized by autoantibodies against desmoglein 3, a cadherin-type cell adhesion molecule in desmosomes. The resulting loss of intercellular adhesion leads to acantholysis and blister formation. Diagnosis is confirmed by direct immunofluorescence revealing intercellular IgG deposits. Early aggressive immunosuppressive therapy reduces mortality.
شرح كامل: The pathogenic antibodies disrupt epithelial integrity causing fragile mucocutaneous blisters. Clinical signs include positive Nikolsky's sign and painful erosions. Prompt diagnosis and treatment with corticosteroids and immunomodulators are critical to prevent fatal complications.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4484): A 28-year-old immunocompetent patient develops multiple bilateral white plaques on the lateral tongue that cannot be scraped off. PCR confirms Epstein-Barr virus. What is the diagnosis and prognosis?
خيار 1: Oral hairy leukoplakia; benign but indicates immunosuppression risk
الإجابة: Oral hairy leukoplakia; benign but indicates immunosuppression risk
التفسير: Oral hairy leukoplakia is an EBV-induced lesion usually seen in immunocompromised individuals, particularly HIV-positive patients. Though benign and non-premalignant, its presence indicates impaired immunity. It presents as painless corrugated white plaques on the lateral tongue. Management focuses on underlying immunosuppression; lesion persistence without malignant transformation is typical.
شرح كامل: Although the patient is immunocompetent, early HIV testing is advised. Antiviral therapy may reduce lesion size but is not curative. The diagnosis relies on clinical features supported by EBV PCR or in situ hybridization. Differentiation from leukoplakia or candidiasis is important for management.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4485): A 65-year-old man with a history of tobacco and alcohol use presents with a painless, firm, ulcerated lesion on the ventral tongue persisting for 2 months. Biopsy reveals invasive squamous cell carcinoma. What is the most important prognostic factor?
التفسير: The presence and extent of regional lymph node metastasis is the most critical prognostic factor in oral squamous cell carcinoma, significantly reducing survival rates. Early detection of nodal disease guides treatment planning, often necessitating neck dissection and adjuvant therapy. Tumor size, histologic grade, and depth of invasion are also important but secondary to nodal involvement.
شرح كامل: Squamous cell carcinoma of the oral cavity typically arises on the lateral tongue or floor of mouth in middle-aged to older adults with known carcinogen exposure. Clinical staging involves TNM classification; imaging and sentinel node biopsy aid detection of occult metastasis. Multidisciplinary management improves outcomes.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4486): A 45-year-old female presents with bilateral painless parotid gland enlargement and dry eyes. Serological tests are negative for anti-Ro and anti-La antibodies. What diagnostic test is most helpful?
التفسير: Despite negative autoantibodies, minor salivary gland biopsy is the gold standard for diagnosing Sjögren’s syndrome, revealing focal lymphocytic sialadenitis with a focus score ≥1. This histopathological finding is critical for diagnosis in seronegative patients. Imaging and functional tests like Schirmer’s support the diagnosis but cannot replace biopsy.
شرح كامل: Sjögren’s syndrome is a chronic autoimmune disorder characterized by lymphocytic infiltration of exocrine glands, primarily affecting middle-aged women. Early diagnosis prevents complications including lymphoma. Multimodal evaluation including clinical, serological, and histological data is essential.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4487): A 32-year-old patient reports recurrent, painful oral ulcers, occurring every 3 weeks, healing without scarring. No systemic disease is noted. Which is the most likely diagnosis?
التفسير: Recurrent aphthous stomatitis (RAS) is characterized by recurrent, painful, shallow ulcers limited to non-keratinized mucosa. The ulcers heal within 7-14 days without scarring. Diagnosis is clinical and of exclusion. Etiology is multifactorial involving immune dysregulation, nutritional deficiencies, and stress. Treatment focuses on symptomatic relief.
شرح كامل: RAS is the most common cause of oral ulcers; differentials include herpetic stomatitis (which involves keratinized mucosa and systemic symptoms) and systemic diseases. Management includes topical corticosteroids and good oral hygiene.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4488): A 55-year-old male presents with a rapidly enlarging painless swelling of the lower lip. Biopsy reveals mucin-producing tumor cells with cystic spaces. What is the diagnosis?
التفسير: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma is the most common malignant salivary gland tumor presenting as painless mass. Histologically, it contains mucous and epidermoid cells forming cystic and solid areas. Prognosis depends on grade; low-grade tumors behave less aggressively than high-grade variants.
شرح كامل: Early diagnosis allows conservative surgery; high-grade tumors require wider resection and possible radiotherapy. Clinical suspicion should be raised for new, persistent salivary gland swellings, especially in middle-aged adults.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4489): A patient presents with diffuse bilateral brown macular pigmentation of oral mucosa, fatigue, and hypotension. Serum cortisol is low. What is the diagnosis?
التفسير: Primary adrenal insufficiency causes increased ACTH and melanocyte-stimulating hormone leading to mucocutaneous hyperpigmentation. Fatigue and hypotension are systemic signs. Oral pigmentation often precedes skin changes and should prompt endocrine evaluation.
شرح كامل: Addison’s disease is a life-threatening condition if unrecognized; treatment includes lifelong steroid replacement. Early oral signs aid diagnosis.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4490): A 40-year-old patient presents with painful oral ulcers and fever two days after starting sulfonamide antibiotics. What is the most likely diagnosis?
التفسير: SJS is a severe mucocutaneous hypersensitivity reaction characterized by widespread necrosis and detachment of epidermis and mucous membranes, often drug-induced. Early withdrawal of offending agent and intensive supportive care are crucial.
شرح كامل: Oral mucosal ulcerations with hemorrhagic crusting and systemic symptoms differentiate SJS from other ulcerative diseases. Hospitalization often required.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4491): A 35-year-old female presents with persistent white plaques on the buccal mucosa that do not scrape off and show hyperkeratosis on biopsy without dysplasia. What is the diagnosis?
التفسير: Leukoplakia is a clinical term for white plaques with potential for malignant transformation. Biopsy rules out dysplasia; lesions without dysplasia require surveillance.
شرح كامل: Risk factors include tobacco and alcohol. Management includes elimination of irritants, surveillance, and excision if dysplasia develops.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4492): A 60-year-old patient with poorly controlled diabetes has erythematous patches on the dorsal tongue with burning sensation. Oral swab cultures Candida albicans. What is the preferred treatment?
التفسير: Erythematous candidiasis is common in immunocompromised and diabetic patients. Topical antifungals such as nystatin or clotrimazole are first-line therapy.
شرح كامل: Systemic antifungals reserved for refractory or widespread infection. Good glycemic control aids treatment.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4493): A 45-year-old woman reports bilateral painful swelling of the parotid glands with dry eyes and mouth. Imaging shows heterogeneous gland architecture. Which biopsy is best?
التفسير: Biopsy of minor salivary glands provides diagnostic histology for Sjögren’s syndrome, showing lymphocytic infiltration and focus score assessment.
شرح كامل: Less invasive than major gland biopsy; important when serology is inconclusive.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4494): A patient has multiple painful oral ulcers lasting over 3 weeks with cervical lymphadenopathy and systemic symptoms. Which diagnosis is most probable?
التفسير: Chronic infectious disease causing granulomatous ulcers, often confused with malignancy; requires biopsy and microbiological confirmation.
شرح كامل: Tuberculous ulcers show irregular margins and undermined edges; anti-TB therapy is essential for cure.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4495): A 30-year-old presents with a painless mass in the floor of mouth that fluctuates in size and transilluminates. What is the diagnosis?
التفسير: Ranula is a mucous extravasation cyst from sublingual gland duct obstruction, typically translucent and fluctuant.
شرح كامل: Surgical excision including gland removal is recommended to prevent recurrence; diagnosis aided by imaging and clinical features.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4496): A 50-year-old man presents with burning mouth, taste disturbance, and no visible lesions. Lab tests are normal. Diagnosis?
التفسير: BMS is a diagnosis of exclusion characterized by chronic oral burning and dysgeusia with no clinical or laboratory abnormalities.
شرح كامل: Neuropathic mechanisms and psychological factors are implicated; management includes counseling and neuropathic pain agents.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4497): A patient has a non-healing exophytic mass on the gingiva with underlying bone destruction on radiographs. Histology reveals malignant squamous cells with keratin pearls. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Malignant lesion requiring prompt biopsy and treatment.
شرح كامل: Gingival SCC can mimic benign lesions; early biopsy crucial. Management includes surgery and possible adjunctive therapy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4498): A 40-year-old woman presents with a firm, painless swelling on the palate. Biopsy shows mixed epithelial and mesenchymal cells with chondroid differentiation. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Most common benign salivary gland tumor with mixed histology.
شرح كامل: Slow growing, usually in parotid or palate; surgical excision with margin necessary to prevent recurrence.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4499): A 60-year-old diabetic presents with necrotizing ulcerative gingivitis, severe halitosis, and bleeding gums. What is the initial treatment?
التفسير: NUG requires prompt removal of necrotic tissue and systemic antibiotics.
شرح كامل: Poor oral hygiene and immunosuppression predispose; treatment includes pain control, antibiotics, and improving oral hygiene to prevent progression.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4500): A 55-year-old presents with bilateral symmetric hyperpigmented macules on oral mucosa and nail dystrophy. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Autosomal dominant syndrome with mucocutaneous pigmentation and intestinal polyposis.
شرح كامل: Pigmentation appears early in life and warrants GI surveillance for polyps with malignant potential.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4501): A 50-year-old patient develops bilateral gingival enlargement after 6 months of calcium channel blocker use. What is the best management?
التفسير: Drug-induced gingival enlargement exacerbated by plaque; good hygiene and alternative drugs help.
شرح كامل: Fibrotic changes may require surgery; however, non-surgical control and medication review are first steps.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4502): A patient has unilateral numbness of lower lip and chin with an intraoral ulcerated mass on the mandible. Radiograph shows destructive lesion. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Neural invasion causes numb chin syndrome, signifying malignancy.
شرح كامل: Early recognition of sensory changes with oral ulcers is critical; biopsy confirms diagnosis and guides therapy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4503): A patient with HIV infection has multiple bluish-purple macules on the palate and gingiva. Diagnosis?
التفسير: AIDS-associated vascular tumor caused by HHV-8.
شرح كامل: KS is the most common malignancy in HIV; lesions may be multiple, ulcerated, and require chemotherapy or radiation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4504): A 60-year-old man with a history of heavy smoking presents with white plaque on ventral tongue, biopsy shows severe dysplasia. Best management?
التفسير: High risk of malignant transformation requires removal.
شرح كامل: Dysplastic leukoplakias require complete excision and close follow-up to prevent progression to invasive carcinoma.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4505): A 40-year-old woman reports recurrent, painful oral ulcers and genital ulcers along with uveitis. Most likely diagnosis?
التفسير: Multisystem inflammatory disorder characterized by recurrent mucosal ulcers and ocular involvement.
شرح كامل: Diagnosis is clinical; systemic immunosuppression often needed to control symptoms and prevent complications.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4506): A 35-year-old presents with a painless, slow-growing submucosal mass on the tongue. MRI shows well-circumscribed lesion with cystic areas. Most likely diagnosis?
التفسير: Pleomorphic adenoma is common with mixed solid and cystic components.
شرح كامل: Surgical excision with margin required to avoid recurrence; imaging aids diagnosis.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4507): A 60-year-old presents with painful ulcerations on the lateral tongue and floor of mouth with significant weight loss. Biopsy shows invasive carcinoma. What is the best imaging for staging?
التفسير: MRI provides excellent soft tissue resolution for staging depth and nodal involvement.
شرح كامل: Imaging guides treatment planning; MRI preferred for soft tissue delineation; CT better for bone involvement.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4508): A 50-year-old patient complains of chronic dry mouth and difficulty swallowing. Sialometry reveals unstimulated salivary flow <0.1 mL/min. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Objective measurement confirming reduced salivary output.
شرح كامل: Hyposalivation leads to increased caries risk, mucosal infections; management includes saliva substitutes and systemic evaluation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4509): A 28-year-old woman develops rapidly progressive facial swelling and multiple oral ulcers following NSAID ingestion. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Severe mucocutaneous hypersensitivity with systemic involvement.
شرح كامل: Immediate withdrawal of offending drug, hospitalization, and supportive care are critical.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4510): A 45-year-old man develops asymptomatic bilateral bluish nodules on the ventral tongue. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Dilated venous structures common in elderly, benign and asymptomatic.
شرح كامل: No treatment required; differentiation from vascular tumors important.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4511): A patient has a history of radiotherapy to head and neck with exposed bone and pain in mandible. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Radiation-induced bone necrosis due to hypovascularity.
شرح كامل: Conservative management includes antibiotics, debridement, hyperbaric oxygen; surgery for refractory cases.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4512): A 55-year-old man presents with a large, painless ulcer on the lateral tongue with rolled indurated margins. What is the next step?
التفسير: To rule out squamous cell carcinoma.
شرح كامل: Early biopsy essential to detect malignancy; prompt diagnosis improves prognosis.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4513): A 50-year-old female presents with bilateral painful oral erosions and conjunctival scarring. Direct immunofluorescence shows linear IgG and C3 deposits at the basement membrane. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Autoimmune subepithelial blistering disease targeting basement membrane zone, often involving oral mucosa and eyes. Early diagnosis essential to prevent blindness.
شرح كامل: MMP causes chronic blistering with scarring; DIF confirms diagnosis. Treatment includes corticosteroids and immunosuppressants. Ocular involvement requires multidisciplinary care.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4514): A 35-year-old HIV-positive patient has white, corrugated plaques on the lateral tongue that cannot be scraped off. PCR detects Epstein-Barr virus. What is the lesion?
التفسير: EBV-induced lesion in immunocompromised patients; benign but indicates immune suppression.
شرح كامل: OHL is a marker of HIV progression; lesions persist without malignant transformation. Treatment focuses on antiretroviral therapy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4515): A 60-year-old man with a 2 cm ulcer on the lateral tongue with indurated margins and no healing for 6 weeks. What is the best next step?
التفسير: Persistent ulcers with induration suspicious for malignancy require histological diagnosis.
شرح كامل: Early biopsy critical to diagnose oral squamous cell carcinoma; delays reduce survival.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4516): A patient reports dry mouth and eyes with positive anti-Ro antibodies and focal lymphocytic infiltration on minor salivary gland biopsy. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Chronic autoimmune exocrinopathy causing sicca symptoms and glandular destruction.
شرح كامل: Diagnosis requires clinical, serological, and histological correlation. Management involves symptomatic relief and monitoring for lymphoma.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4517): A 45-year-old woman develops painful recurrent oral ulcers every 4 weeks lasting 7-10 days. No systemic disease. Most likely diagnosis?
التفسير: Idiopathic recurrent ulceration confined to oral mucosa.
شرح كامل: Diagnosis of exclusion; treatment includes topical corticosteroids and avoidance of triggers.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4518): A 55-year-old man with swelling of parotid gland and pain worsened during meals. Ultrasound shows hyperechoic mass in duct. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Salivary duct stones causing obstruction and gland swelling.
شرح كامل: Stones obstruct salivary flow causing swelling and pain. Imaging guides surgical removal or lithotripsy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4519): A 65-year-old smoker has diffuse white plaques on the buccal mucosa that cannot be scraped off. Biopsy reveals hyperkeratosis without dysplasia. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Clinical white lesion with potential premalignant risk; histology guides management.
شرح كامل: Risk factor modification and surveillance essential; dysplastic lesions may require excision.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4520): A 40-year-old diabetic patient develops erythematous painful patches on the dorsal tongue. Oral swab positive for Candida albicans. Best treatment?
التفسير: Erythematous candidiasis requires antifungal therapy to eradicate infection.
شرح كامل: Diabetes predisposes to candidiasis; glycemic control essential for prevention and treatment.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4521): A 28-year-old presents with painful, multiple oral ulcers preceded by fever and malaise. Oral exam shows vesicles and ulcerations on keratinized mucosa. Most likely diagnosis?
التفسير: HSV primary infection causes vesicular stomatitis in children and young adults.
شرح كامل: Systemic symptoms accompany painful oral lesions; antiviral therapy shortens course.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4522): A 50-year-old presents with rapidly growing painless swelling of the lower lip, biopsy shows mucin-producing tumor cells. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Most common malignant salivary gland tumor with variable aggressiveness.
شرح كامل: Early diagnosis and complete excision improve prognosis; high-grade tumors require adjunct therapy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4523): A 55-year-old woman has bilateral brown macular pigmentation of oral mucosa, fatigue, and hypotension. Serum cortisol is low. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Adrenal insufficiency causes hyperpigmentation due to ACTH increase.
شرح كامل: Oral pigmentation may precede systemic symptoms; corticosteroid replacement is treatment.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4524): A patient develops widespread mucosal blistering after starting sulfonamide antibiotics. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Severe mucocutaneous hypersensitivity with systemic involvement.
شرح كامل: Drug withdrawal and supportive care are vital; mortality risk significant.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4525): A 35-year-old woman has painful gingival swelling and bleeding after 3 months of phenytoin therapy. Best management?
خيار 1: Improve oral hygiene and consider drug change
الإجابة: Improve oral hygiene and consider drug change
التفسير: Drug-induced gingival overgrowth exacerbated by plaque.
شرح كامل: Plaque control reduces severity; alternative medications minimize recurrence; surgery for persistent cases.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4526): A 45-year-old with persistent leukoplakia on ventral tongue shows severe dysplasia on biopsy. Management?
التفسير: High-risk lesion requiring removal to prevent malignancy.
شرح كامل: Complete excision with margins advised; regular follow-up necessary to monitor recurrence.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4527): A 60-year-old diabetic patient presents with necrotizing ulcerative gingivitis and severe halitosis. Treatment?
التفسير: Acute infection requires prompt therapy to prevent progression.
شرح كامل: Painful necrosis of interdental papillae treated with professional cleaning, systemic antibiotics, and improved oral hygiene.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4528): A 28-year-old woman has recurrent painful genital and oral ulcers with uveitis. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Multisystem inflammatory vasculitis with mucocutaneous and ocular involvement.
شرح كامل: Diagnosis is clinical; systemic immunosuppressants required to control disease and prevent complications.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4529): A 40-year-old presents with painless, firm swelling on the hard palate. Biopsy shows mixed epithelial and mesenchymal cells with cartilaginous differentiation. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Most common benign salivary gland tumor with diverse histology.
شرح كامل: Surgical excision with margin required to prevent recurrence; usually slow growing and painless.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4530): A 60-year-old presents with a painless ulcer on lateral tongue with rolled, indurated margins. Best investigation?
التفسير: To confirm or exclude malignancy.
شرح كامل: Early diagnosis and staging essential for optimal treatment and improved prognosis.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4531): A patient has xerostomia with salivary flow <0.1 mL/min. What is the diagnosis?
التفسير: Objective reduction in saliva production leading to dry mouth symptoms.
شرح كامل: Causes include autoimmune disease, medication side effects, and radiation; management focuses on symptom relief and preventing complications.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4532): A 28-year-old develops rapidly progressing mucosal ulcers with skin target lesions after NSAID use. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Severe drug-induced mucocutaneous hypersensitivity.
شرح كامل: Prompt withdrawal of causative drug and supportive care required; mortality risk high without treatment.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4533): A 45-year-old presents with multiple bilateral bluish nodules on ventral tongue, asymptomatic. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Dilated veins common in elderly, benign and asymptomatic.
شرح كامل: Varicosities do not require treatment; differentiate from vascular tumors by clinical examination.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4534): A patient with prior radiation therapy develops exposed necrotic bone in mandible with pain. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Radiation-induced avascular necrosis of bone.
شرح كامل: Management includes antibiotics, debridement, hyperbaric oxygen; surgery if refractory.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4535): A 50-year-old patient has a non-healing ulcerated lesion on the lateral tongue with rolled borders. Next step?
التفسير: To rule out squamous cell carcinoma.
شرح كامل: Early histological diagnosis critical; delayed diagnosis worsens outcomes.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4536): A 55-year-old HIV-positive patient presents with bluish-purple macules on palate and gingiva. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Vascular neoplasm associated with HHV-8 in immunocompromised hosts.
شرح كامل: KS lesions may be multiple and ulcerate; treatment includes HAART and chemotherapy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4537): A 45-year-old with heavy smoking history has white plaque on tongue with severe dysplasia on biopsy. Management?
التفسير: High risk of malignant transformation requires removal.
شرح كامل: Complete excision and surveillance mandatory; risk factor cessation advised.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4538): A 40-year-old woman has recurrent oral and genital ulcers and ocular inflammation. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Multisystem vasculitis with mucocutaneous and ocular symptoms.
شرح كامل: Requires systemic immunosuppression; early diagnosis important to prevent blindness.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4539): A 35-year-old presents with painless, slow-growing tongue swelling showing cystic areas on imaging. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Benign salivary tumor with mixed tissue components.
شرح كامل: Surgical excision required; recurrence possible if incompletely removed.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4540): A 60-year-old diabetic has painful necrotizing gingivitis with halitosis and bleeding. Treatment?
التفسير: Acute infection needing urgent therapy to prevent progression.
شرح كامل: NUG caused by anaerobic bacteria; treatment includes mechanical cleaning and systemic antibiotics.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4541): A 55-year-old man has brown macular oral pigmentation with nail dystrophy. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Genetic disorder with mucocutaneous pigmentation and GI polyposis.
شرح كامل: Requires monitoring for malignancy; oral pigmentation is early sign.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4542): A patient on calcium channel blockers develops gingival overgrowth. Best management?
التفسير: Medication-induced enlargement worsened by plaque accumulation.
شرح كامل: Good oral hygiene essential; drug substitution reduces overgrowth; surgery for persistent cases.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4543): Which type of aphthous ulcer is typically >1 cm, heals with scarring, and may last weeks?
التفسير: Major aphthous ulcers are larger, deeper, more painful, and heal with scarring over weeks.
شرح كامل: Differentiation from minor and herpetiform ulcers is important for management and prognosis. Major ulcers often require systemic therapy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4544): The primary causative agent of oral candidiasis is?
التفسير: Candida albicans is the most common fungal pathogen causing oral candidiasis.
شرح كامل: Opportunistic infection in immunocompromised or antibiotic-treated patients; clinical forms include pseudomembranous, erythematous, and chronic hyperplastic.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4545): Which vesiculobullous disorder shows intraepithelial blistering with positive Nikolsky’s sign?
التفسير: Pemphigus vulgaris features acantholysis leading to intraepithelial blistering and positive Nikolsky’s sign.
شرح كامل: Autoantibodies against desmogleins disrupt cell adhesion; diagnosis by biopsy and immunofluorescence.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4546): The hallmark histological feature of oral lichen planus is?
خيار 1: Saw-tooth shaped rete ridges with band-like lymphocytic infiltrate
الإجابة: Saw-tooth shaped rete ridges with band-like lymphocytic infiltrate
التفسير: Characteristic basal cell degeneration with dense subepithelial lymphocytes.
شرح كامل: Histology helps differentiate lichen planus from lichenoid reactions and leukoplakia.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4547): Which serological marker is most specific for Sjögren’s syndrome?
التفسير: Anti-Ro is the most specific and commonly detected antibody in Sjögren’s.
شرح كامل: Along with clinical and histological features, serology confirms diagnosis and guides management.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4548): The “cotton wool” appearance on jaw radiographs is characteristic of?
التفسير: Disorganized bone remodeling leads to patchy sclerosis.
شرح كامل: Radiographic findings correspond to clinical bone enlargement and deformity; biochemical markers include elevated alkaline phosphatase.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4549): A persistent white plaque that cannot be scraped off and has a 5% risk of malignant transformation is called?
التفسير: Leukoplakia is a potentially malignant disorder requiring biopsy and follow-up.
شرح كامل: Differentiating from other white lesions is critical; risk factors include tobacco and alcohol.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4550): Which viral infection is associated with oral hairy leukoplakia?
التفسير: EBV reactivation causes OHL in immunocompromised patients.
شرح كامل: OHL is a marker for HIV/AIDS progression; lesions are asymptomatic and typically on lateral tongue.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4551): A 35-year-old patient with dry mouth, dry eyes, and positive anti-Ro antibodies most likely has?
التفسير: Classic autoimmune exocrinopathy with sicca symptoms.
شرح كامل: Diagnosis includes clinical, serological, and histological evidence; management is symptomatic and immunomodulatory.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4552): The first-line treatment for mild oral candidiasis is?
التفسير: Nystatin or clotrimazole are effective initial therapies.
شرح كامل: Systemic antifungals reserved for severe or refractory cases; underlying causes must be addressed.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4553): Which type of oral cancer accounts for >90% of malignancies in the oral cavity?
التفسير: Most oral malignancies arise from squamous epithelium.
شرح كامل: Risk factors include tobacco, alcohol, HPV; early diagnosis improves prognosis.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4554): What is the typical incubation period of primary herpetic gingivostomatitis?
التفسير: HSV primary infection develops within about a week.
شرح كامل: Presents with painful vesicles and ulcers in children and young adults; treatment is supportive and antiviral therapy if early.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4555): Which drug is most commonly associated with gingival overgrowth?
التفسير: Antiepileptic drug causing gingival fibroblast proliferation.
شرح كامل: Management includes plaque control, drug substitution, and surgical intervention if needed.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4556): A 50-year-old patient with dry mouth and salivary flow <0.1 mL/min is diagnosed with?
التفسير: Objective decrease in salivary secretion causing xerostomia.
شرح كامل: Causes include autoimmune diseases, medication side effects, radiation; management includes saliva substitutes and systemic therapy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4557): Which salivary gland tumor commonly exhibits perineural invasion and causes pain?
التفسير: Malignant tumor with marked nerve involvement.
شرح كامل: Requires aggressive surgical and adjuvant treatment; poor prognosis due to recurrence and metastasis.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4558): The primary lesion in erythema multiforme is?
التفسير: Typical concentric rings of erythema on skin.
شرح كامل: EM is immune-mediated with mucocutaneous involvement; HSV often triggers; treatment supportive.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4559): A 40-year-old female presents with chronic bilateral parotid swelling and xerostomia but negative autoantibodies. What is the next best step?
التفسير: Confirms diagnosis of Sjögren’s syndrome histologically in seronegative cases.
شرح كامل: Focal lymphocytic sialadenitis with focus score ≥1 confirms diagnosis; guides management.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4560): Burning mouth syndrome is best described as?
خيار 1: Chronic oral burning without clinical signs
الإجابة: Chronic oral burning without clinical signs
التفسير: Idiopathic neuropathic pain disorder.
شرح كامل: Diagnosis of exclusion; management includes pain control, behavioral therapy, and neuropathic medications.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4561): The characteristic radiographic finding in Paget’s disease is?
التفسير: Mixed radiolucent-radiopaque bone changes.
شرح كامل: Results from abnormal bone remodeling; clinically bone enlargement and deformities occur.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4562): What is the hallmark of oral hairy leukoplakia?
التفسير: EBV-induced lesion in immunosuppressed patients.
شرح كامل: OHL is non-malignant but indicates immunosuppression; diagnosis confirmed by EBV detection.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4563): Which vitamin deficiency causes atrophic glossitis and angular stomatitis?
التفسير: Impairs DNA synthesis leading to mucosal atrophy and fissuring.
شرح كامل: Symptoms include burning tongue and anemia; supplementation corrects symptoms.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4564): A 60-year-old smoker has a non-healing ulcer on lateral tongue with biopsy confirming squamous cell carcinoma. What is the most important prognostic factor?
التفسير: Presence of nodal disease greatly worsens prognosis.
شرح كامل: Nodal involvement indicates advanced disease; treatment includes neck dissection and adjuvant therapy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4565): Which of the following is the first-line treatment for mild erythematous oral candidiasis?
التفسير: Nystatin or clotrimazole are used initially.
شرح كامل: Systemic therapy reserved for severe or refractory cases; address underlying factors.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4566): Stevens-Johnson syndrome is most commonly triggered by?
التفسير: Medications like sulfonamides, anticonvulsants.
شرح كامل: Severe mucocutaneous reaction with extensive necrosis; drug withdrawal is critical.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4567): The best initial test to confirm Sjögren’s syndrome in a seronegative patient is?
التفسير: Histology shows lymphocytic infiltration confirming diagnosis.
شرح كامل: Helps differentiate from other causes of xerostomia; guides treatment.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4568): A painless, slow-growing swelling in the posterior mandible with multilocular “soap bubble” radiographic appearance is?
التفسير: Benign but locally aggressive odontogenic tumor.
شرح كامل: Requires surgical excision with margins due to recurrence risk.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4569): Which antibody is positive in pemphigus vulgaris?
التفسير: Autoantibody against desmoglein 3 causing acantholysis.
شرح كامل: Target antigen disruption leads to intraepithelial blistering and erosions.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4570): The typical incubation period for primary herpes simplex infection is?
التفسير: Period from exposure to clinical symptoms.
شرح كامل: HSV infection causes gingivostomatitis in primary cases, common in children.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4571): A patient with recurrent painful ulcers on non-keratinized mucosa, healing without scarring, most likely has?
التفسير: Common idiopathic ulcers; diagnosis of exclusion.
شرح كامل: Management focuses on symptomatic relief; excludes systemic disease.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4572): Which tumor is most common benign salivary gland neoplasm?
التفسير: Mixed tumor with epithelial and mesenchymal components.
شرح كامل: Slow growing, painless; surgical removal with margins to prevent recurrence.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4573): A 48-year-old woman presents with painful erosive lesions on the buccal mucosa and a positive Nikolsky’s sign. What is the most likely diagnosis?
التفسير: Pemphigus vulgaris is an autoimmune intraepithelial blistering disease characterized by acantholysis. The positive Nikolsky’s sign indicates epidermal fragility. Diagnosis is confirmed by direct immunofluorescence showing intercellular IgG deposits. Early treatment is critical to reduce morbidity and mortality.
شرح كامل: Autoimmune blistering diseases

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4574): A 33-year-old HIV-positive man develops white corrugated plaques on the lateral tongue that do not rub off. Which virus is responsible?
التفسير: Oral hairy leukoplakia is caused by EBV reactivation in immunocompromised patients, presenting as non-removable white plaques on the lateral tongue. It is a marker of HIV progression but not premalignant.
شرح كامل: Viral oral lesions

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4575): A 60-year-old heavy smoker has a persistent ulcer on the lateral border of the tongue. Which investigation is most important?
التفسير: Persistent oral ulcers with indurated borders must be biopsied to rule out squamous cell carcinoma. Early diagnosis is key for prognosis.
شرح كامل: Oral oncology

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4576): A 45-year-old woman presents with dry mouth and positive anti-Ro and anti-La antibodies. What is the diagnosis?
التفسير: Sjögren’s syndrome is a chronic autoimmune disease affecting salivary and lacrimal glands causing sicca symptoms. Positive anti-Ro and anti-La antibodies are diagnostic markers. Management includes symptom control and monitoring for lymphoma.
شرح كامل: Autoimmune diseases

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4577): A 29-year-old woman reports painful recurrent oral ulcers with no systemic symptoms. What is the most likely diagnosis?
التفسير: Recurrent aphthous stomatitis causes small painful ulcers typically on non-keratinized mucosa. It is idiopathic and diagnosed clinically by exclusion of systemic disease. Treatment is symptomatic.
شرح كامل: Ulcerative disorders

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4578): A 50-year-old patient has swelling and pain in the parotid gland aggravated by eating. Ultrasound shows a hyperechoic lesion in the duct. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Salivary stones cause obstruction leading to gland swelling and pain especially during meals. Ultrasound is useful for detection. Management includes removal of the stone.
شرح كامل: Salivary gland disorders

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4579): A 55-year-old man presents with white plaques on the buccal mucosa that cannot be scraped off. Biopsy shows hyperkeratosis without dysplasia. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Leukoplakia is a white lesion with risk for malignant transformation. Biopsy is essential to exclude dysplasia or carcinoma. Management involves removing irritants and monitoring.
شرح كامل: Precancerous lesions

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4580): A 42-year-old diabetic patient presents with red patches and burning sensation on the tongue. Candida albicans is isolated. Treatment?
التفسير: Erythematous candidiasis in diabetics is treated effectively with topical antifungals such as nystatin or clotrimazole.
شرح كامل: Fungal infections

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4581): A 27-year-old patient presents with painful oral vesicles and ulcers involving keratinized mucosa and fever. Diagnosis?
التفسير: HSV primary infection presents with painful vesicles on keratinized mucosa and systemic symptoms. Antiviral treatment is effective if started early.
شرح كامل: Viral infections

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4582): A 53-year-old patient with painless swelling of the lower lip. Biopsy reveals mucin-producing tumor cells with cystic spaces. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma is a malignant salivary gland tumor with mixed cell types and cystic spaces. Treatment depends on grade and extent.
شرح كامل: Salivary gland tumors

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4583): A 54-year-old presents with fatigue, hyperpigmented oral mucosa, and hypotension. Cortisol levels are low. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Primary adrenal insufficiency leads to increased ACTH causing mucocutaneous pigmentation. Oral pigmentation can precede systemic symptoms.
شرح كامل: Endocrine disorders

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4584): A 36-year-old develops extensive oral mucosal ulceration and skin target lesions after sulfonamide use. Diagnosis?
التفسير: SJS is a severe mucocutaneous drug reaction requiring urgent drug withdrawal and supportive care.
شرح كامل: Drug reactions

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4585): A patient on phenytoin presents with gingival overgrowth. Management?
خيار 1: Improve oral hygiene and consider drug change
الإجابة: Improve oral hygiene and consider drug change
التفسير: Drug-induced gingival enlargement is worsened by plaque; controlling hygiene and switching drugs helps.
شرح كامل: Drug reactions

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4586): A 44-year-old with leukoplakia on tongue biopsy shows severe dysplasia. Treatment?
التفسير: Severe dysplasia carries high malignant potential; excision and close follow-up are required.
شرح كامل: Precancerous lesions

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4587): A 61-year-old diabetic has necrotizing ulcerative gingivitis. Treatment?
التفسير: Acute necrotizing infection requiring prompt mechanical and antibiotic therapy.
شرح كامل: Infectious diseases

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4588): A 32-year-old reports recurrent oral and genital ulcers with uveitis. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Multisystem inflammatory disorder; systemic immunosuppression is needed.
شرح كامل: Autoimmune diseases

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4589): A 40-year-old presents with painless swelling on the hard palate, biopsy reveals pleomorphic adenoma. Treatment?
التفسير: Benign mixed tumor; complete removal prevents recurrence.
شرح كامل: Salivary gland tumors

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4590): A patient presents with ulcerated, indurated lesion on lateral tongue. Next step?
التفسير: To exclude squamous cell carcinoma.
شرح كامل: Oncology

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4591): A patient with xerostomia has unstimulated saliva flow <0.1 mL/min. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Objective reduced saliva production; management is symptomatic.
شرح كامل: Salivary disorders

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4592): A 30-year-old develops mucosal ulcers and target skin lesions after NSAID ingestion. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Severe mucocutaneous drug reaction requiring urgent care.
شرح كامل: Drug reactions

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4593): A 45-year-old has multiple bluish nodules on ventral tongue. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Dilated veins common in elderly; benign.
شرح كامل: Vascular lesions

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4594): A patient with history of head and neck radiation develops exposed necrotic bone. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Radiation-induced bone necrosis due to hypoxia.
شرح كامل: Bone complications

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4595): A patient presents with non-healing ulcer on tongue with rolled borders. Next step?
التفسير: To rule out malignancy.
شرح كامل: Oncology

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4596): A 55-year-old HIV-positive patient has bluish-purple oral macules. Diagnosis?
التفسير: Vascular tumor associated with HHV-8 in immunocompromised.
شرح كامل: Viral oncogenesis

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4597): A 45-year-old smoker has tongue leukoplakia with severe dysplasia. Management?
التفسير: High malignant potential; excision and follow-up necessary.
شرح كامل: Precancerous lesions

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4598): A 40-year-old with recurrent oral/genital ulcers and ocular symptoms likely has?
التفسير: Multisystem inflammatory disorder requiring immunosuppression.
شرح كامل: Autoimmune diseases

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4599): A painless submucosal tongue swelling with cystic areas on MRI likely is?
التفسير: Benign salivary tumor; surgical excision required.
شرح كامل: Tumors

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4600): A 60-year-old diabetic with painful gingivitis and halitosis has necrotizing ulcerative gingivitis. Treatment?
التفسير: Infection control and plaque removal needed.
شرح كامل: Infectious diseases

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4601): A 55-year-old with brown oral pigmentation and nail dystrophy has?
التفسير: Genetic syndrome with mucocutaneous pigmentation and GI polyps.
شرح كامل: Genetic syndromes

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4602): A patient on calcium channel blockers develops gingival enlargement. Best management?
التفسير: Medication-induced gingival overgrowth improved by hygiene and drug change.
شرح كامل: Drug side effects

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4603): crown and bridge
التفسير: crown and bridge
رابط الصورة: crown and bridge

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4604): What is the main goal of fixed prosthodontics?
خيار 1: To replace missing teeth with removable dentures
خيار 2: To restore teeth with permanent restorations cemented to natural teeth
الإجابة: To restore teeth with permanent restorations cemented to natural teeth
التفسير: Fixed prosthodontics focuses on permanently replacing or restoring teeth via cemented restorations.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4605): Which of the following is NOT considered a fixed prosthesis?
التفسير: Partial dentures are removable prostheses.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4606): The primary purpose of a pontic in a fixed partial denture is to:
خيار 1: Attach the bridge to the abutment
التفسير: The pontic replaces missing teeth in a bridge.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4607): Which of these is a commonly used impression material for fixed prosthodontics?
التفسير: PVS is widely used due to its accuracy and dimensional stability.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4608): Which dental cement is best for luting metal-ceramic crowns?
التفسير: Resin cements provide better retention and bonding for metal-ceramic crowns.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4609): What is the ideal total occlusal convergence (taper) of a tooth preparation?
التفسير: An occlusal convergence of approximately 10–15° is ideal for retention; 12° is commonly accepted.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4610): A shoulder finish line is most commonly used for:
التفسير: Shoulder finish lines provide adequate thickness for ceramics.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4611): Which of the following increases the retention of a fixed prosthesis?
التفسير: More parallel walls increase frictional resistance and retention.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4612): Resistance form in tooth preparation prevents:
خيار 2: Dislodgement by forces other than removal
الإجابة: Dislodgement by forces other than removal
التفسير: Resistance form prevents displacement by lateral or functional forces.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4613): Which impression technique is commonly used for fixed prosthodontics?
التفسير: Single-step putty-wash is efficient and accurate for fixed prostheses.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4614): Which metal alloy is commonly used in full cast crowns?
التفسير: Type IV gold alloys are strong and used for fixed prostheses.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4615): The minimum thickness recommended for ceramic material in crowns is approximately:
التفسير: Minimum thickness for ceramics to withstand occlusal forces is about 1 mm.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4616): Provisional crowns are used to:
التفسير: Provisional crowns protect teeth and maintain function before final restoration.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4617): Which factor most affects the accuracy of an impression?
خيار 3: Proper tissue management and moisture control
الإجابة: Proper tissue management and moisture control
التفسير: Moisture control and tissue management ensure detailed, accurate impressions.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4618): Which type of margin provides the best esthetics for anterior all-ceramic crowns?
التفسير: Shoulder margins provide a wide, flat ledge ideal for ceramic layering.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4619): What is the main cause of marginal leakage in fixed prostheses?
التفسير: Improper cementation can leave gaps that cause leakage.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4620): Which impression material sets by addition polymerization?
التفسير: PVS sets by addition polymerization, which has minimal shrinkage.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4621): The purpose of a die spacer is to:
خيار 2: Provide space for the luting cement
الإجابة: Provide space for the luting cement
التفسير: Die spacer creates a uniform space for cement thickness.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4622): Which of the following cements releases fluoride and chemically bonds to dentin?
التفسير: Glass ionomer cements release fluoride and bond chemically to tooth structure.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4623): What is the recommended length of axial walls in tooth preparation for adequate retention?
التفسير: Axial wall height of 3–4 mm is recommended for retention.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4624): What is the main function of the finish line in tooth preparation?
خيار 2: To provide a seat for the restoration margin
الإجابة: To provide a seat for the restoration margin
التفسير: The finish line defines the boundary for the restoration margin and ensures proper seating.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4625): Which finish line is preferred for full metal crowns?
التفسير: Chamfer margins provide adequate support and are easy to prepare for metal crowns.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4626): Which factor does NOT significantly affect the retention of a fixed prosthesis?
التفسير: Tooth color does not affect retention.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4627): What is the ideal axial wall height for molar tooth preparations?
التفسير: Molar axial wall height of ~3 mm is required for retention and resistance.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4628): Cantilever fixed partial dentures rely heavily on:
التفسير: Cantilever bridges have a pontic supported by only one abutment, requiring strong retention.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4629): What is a common contraindication for placing a resin-bonded bridge?
التفسير: Resin-bonded bridges are contraindicated in areas with heavy occlusal load.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4630): The term “biologic width” refers to:
خيار 2: Width of attached gingiva and junctional epithelium
الإجابة: Width of attached gingiva and junctional epithelium
التفسير: Biologic width includes junctional epithelium and connective tissue attachment.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4631): What is the main disadvantage of a cantilever FPD?
التفسير: Cantilever FPDs place excessive stress on supporting teeth.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4632): Which pontic design provides the best hygiene and cleansability?
التفسير: Sanitary pontics have no tissue contact, making cleaning easier.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4633): The connector in a fixed partial denture should be designed to:
خيار 4: Be placed at the pontic margin
التفسير: Connectors must resist occlusal forces without fracture.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4634): Which is the strongest type of dental casting alloy for crowns and bridges?
التفسير: Type IV gold alloys have the highest strength and are used for fixed prostheses.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4635): The term "proximal contact" in fixed prosthodontics refers to:
التفسير: Proximal contacts prevent food impaction and maintain periodontal health.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4636): Which of the following is NOT a primary requirement for abutment teeth?
التفسير: While bonding can help, primary abutment requirements focus on periodontal support and crown-root ratio.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4637): Which of the following is the most critical factor in determining the success of a fixed partial denture?
التفسير: Proper abutment design ensures longevity and retention of the FPD.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4638): Which of these pontic types is contraindicated in esthetic zones due to poor appearance?
التفسير: Sanitary pontics have a large gap under them, which looks unesthetic in anterior teeth.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4639): What is the main reason for providing a chamfer margin rather than a knife-edge margin in fixed prosthodontics?
التفسير: Chamfer margins offer a better finish line for casting and porcelain application.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4640): The most common cause of failure in fixed partial dentures is:
التفسير: Loss of retention is the leading cause of FPD failure.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4641): Which feature in a tooth preparation increases resistance form?
خيار 2: Flat axial walls with added grooves
الإجابة: Flat axial walls with added grooves
التفسير: Flat walls with grooves resist dislodgement better than tapered walls alone.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4642): The term “gingival retraction” refers to:
خيار 2: Temporarily displacing gingiva to expose finish lines
الإجابة: Temporarily displacing gingiva to expose finish lines
التفسير: Retraction cord or paste displaces gingiva temporarily for accurate impression.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4643): What is the minimum occlusocervical height required for molars to ensure retention?
التفسير: 3–4 mm axial wall height is needed for adequate retention on molars.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4644): Which impression material is most dimensionally stable for delayed pouring?
التفسير: PVS has excellent dimensional stability and can be poured multiple times.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4645): What is the purpose of using a retraction cord before impression making?
خيار 2: To temporarily displace gingival tissue and expose margins
الإجابة: To temporarily displace gingival tissue and expose margins
التفسير: Retraction cords provide clear access to finish lines for impression accuracy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4646): Which tray type is preferred for final impressions in fixed prosthodontics?
التفسير: Custom trays provide better fit and minimize distortion in final impressions.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4647): What is a major disadvantage of alginate as an impression material in fixed prosthodontics?
التفسير: Alginate impressions must be poured immediately to avoid distortion.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4648): Which provisional material is commonly used for fabricating temporary crowns?
التفسير: PMMA is popular for its strength and ease of use in temporaries.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4649): What is the main purpose of a provisional crown?
التفسير: Provisionals protect prepared teeth and maintain function during fabrication.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4650): Which of the following is NOT a requirement for provisional restorations?
التفسير: Provisionals are temporary and don’t need to last long-term.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4651): When cementing a provisional crown, the cement used should be:
التفسير: Temporary cements allow easy removal without damaging the tooth.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4652): Which of the following luting cements provides the highest bond strength?
التفسير: Resin cements bond strongly to tooth structure and restorative materials.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4653): What is the main disadvantage of zinc phosphate cement?
التفسير: Zinc phosphate is acidic and can irritate pulp if dentin is not protected.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4654): Which cement is most commonly used for luting all-ceramic crowns?
التفسير: Resin cements provide strong bonding necessary for ceramics.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4655): What is the working time of polyvinyl siloxane impression materials?
التفسير: PVS typically has a working time of about 3–6 minutes depending on formulation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4656): The “double mix” impression technique involves:
خيار 1: Using two different impression materials with different viscosities
الإجابة: Using two different impression materials with different viscosities
التفسير: Heavy body material in tray and light body around tooth ensures accuracy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4657): What is the primary cause of failure in provisional crowns?
التفسير: Poor marginal adaptation can lead to sensitivity and decay under provisionals.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4658): Which of these is a characteristic of polyether impression materials?
التفسير: Polyether materials are very hydrophilic, making them good in moist environments.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4659): Which factor does NOT affect the setting time of impression materials?
التفسير: Patient age does not influence material setting.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4660): Which temporary crown fabrication technique allows indirect fabrication outside the mouth?
التفسير: Indirect technique fabricates the provisional on a model outside the mouth.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4661): Which of the following cements is suitable for cementing provisional restorations?
التفسير: This cement is easy to remove and provides good sealing for provisionals.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4662): The ideal cement thickness for permanent luting agents should be approximately:
التفسير: Thin cement layers improve retention and minimize marginal gaps.
