Q(4664): What is the purpose of waxing up a fixed prosthesis on a die?
خيار 2: To design the shape and contours of the restoration before casting
الإجابة: To design the shape and contours of the restoration before casting
التفسير: The wax-up helps the technician create an accurate shape, contacts, and contours for the final restoration.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4665): Which technique is commonly used to cast metal frameworks for fixed prostheses?
التفسير: The lost wax technique allows precise casting of metal by burning out wax and pouring molten metal.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4666): What is the main advantage of CAD/CAM technology in fixed prosthodontics?
خيار 2: Increased accuracy and reduced human error
الإجابة: Increased accuracy and reduced human error
التفسير: CAD/CAM allows digital design and milling, improving precision and reducing errors in restoration fabrication.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4667): What material is commonly used for CAD/CAM milled crowns?
التفسير: Zirconia is widely used for its strength, esthetics, and suitability for CAD/CAM milling.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4668): Which factor is critical in achieving proper occlusion in fixed prosthodontics?
التفسير: Proper occlusion requires precise records of how teeth come together to avoid premature contacts or trauma.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4669): What is the term for the static relationship between maxillary and mandibular teeth when the jaws are closed?
التفسير: Maximum intercuspation is the habitual position where teeth fit best together.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4670): What is "centric relation"?
خيار 1: Position of the mandible when muscles are relaxed and condyles are in the most superior and anterior position
خيار 2: The position where teeth fit together best
خيار 3: The maximum opening of the jaw
خيار 4: The rest position of the tongue
الإجابة: Position of the mandible when muscles are relaxed and condyles are in the most superior and anterior position
التفسير: Centric relation is a reproducible joint position independent of tooth contact, important for prosthetic treatment.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4671): Which occlusal scheme is recommended for fixed partial dentures to reduce stress on abutments?
التفسير: This scheme protects anterior teeth in excursions and posterior teeth in centric occlusion, reducing stress.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4672): Which articulator type allows adjustment in three planes (horizontal, vertical, and lateral)?
التفسير: Semi-adjustable articulators allow replication of individual jaw movements in three dimensions.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4673): What is a common cause of occlusal discrepancies in fixed restorations?
التفسير: Poor records lead to incorrect occlusal contacts causing discomfort and failure.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4674): Why is the die spacer applied during laboratory procedures?
خيار 2: To increase the size of the die
خيار 3: To protect the die from damage
التفسير: Die spacer creates uniform space so cement can fit between tooth and restoration without interference.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4675): What is the main disadvantage of porcelain-fused-to-metal (PFM) restorations?
التفسير: PFM crowns may show a dark line at the margin, compromising esthetics especially in anterior teeth.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4676): Which of the following is NOT a benefit of digital impressions over conventional impressions?
التفسير: Digital impression systems require significant upfront investment.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4677): What is the purpose of occlusal adjustment after cementation of a fixed prosthesis?
خيار 2: Remove premature contacts and achieve harmonious occlusion
الإجابة: Remove premature contacts and achieve harmonious occlusion
التفسير: Adjusting occlusion prevents trauma, discomfort, and restoration failure.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4678): What is the minimum thickness recommended for metal coping in a PFM crown?
التفسير: Metal coping thickness around 0.3 mm provides adequate strength without excessive bulk.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4679): In occlusion, "excursive movements" refer to:
التفسير: Excursive movements are lateral or protrusive movements during function or parafunction.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4680): What is "interocclusal clearance"?
خيار 1: Distance between teeth in centric occlusion
خيار 2: Space between teeth when mouth is open
الإجابة: Distance between teeth in centric occlusion
التفسير: Interocclusal clearance is important to provide room for restorative material without occlusal interference.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4681): Which factor is important to prevent distortion of impression materials?
التفسير: Some impression materials distort over time; pouring immediately ensures accuracy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4682): Which articulator is considered the most accurate for full mouth rehabilitation?
التفسير: Fully adjustable articulators simulate jaw movements precisely for complex cases.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4683): Why is an occlusal rim used during prosthodontic procedures?
خيار 2: To record vertical dimension and centric relation
الإجابة: To record vertical dimension and centric relation
التفسير: Occlusal rims help establish proper jaw relationship and vertical dimension in prosthetic fabrication.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4684): What is the most common cause of sensitivity after crown cementation?
خيار 2: Pulpal inflammation due to dentin exposure
الإجابة: Pulpal inflammation due to dentin exposure
التفسير: Over-preparation or exposure of dentinal tubules can cause sensitivity post-cementation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4685): Which is a common mechanical failure of fixed prostheses?
التفسير: Loss of cement leads to microleakage and prosthesis instability.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4686): Marginal discrepancy in crowns can lead to:
التفسير: Poor marginal fit allows bacterial infiltration causing decay and gingival inflammation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4687): What is a common biological complication in fixed prosthodontics?
التفسير: Caries can develop if margins are not well adapted or if oral hygiene is poor.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4688): Which factor most influences the esthetics of an all-ceramic crown?
التفسير: Adequate ceramic thickness is essential for translucency and color matching.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4689): What is “chipping” in ceramic restorations?
خيار 2: Small fractures or loss of ceramic glaze
الإجابة: Small fractures or loss of ceramic glaze
التفسير: Chipping refers to surface cracks or loss of porcelain causing roughness and esthetic issues.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4690): Which is NOT recommended to prevent porcelain fracture in fixed prostheses?
التفسير: Very bulky connectors may induce stress but are usually protective; thin connectors increase fracture risk.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4691): What should be done if a fixed prosthesis fractures after cementation?
التفسير: Fractured restorations must be replaced or repaired to restore function and esthetics.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4692): Which is a common cause of debonding of resin-bonded bridges?
التفسير: Lack of sufficient enamel or contamination during bonding causes debonding.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4693): What is the role of “opal glaze” on ceramic restorations?
التفسير: Glazing gives ceramic restorations a natural shine and smooth surface to reduce plaque accumulation.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4694): What is a common aesthetic complication with metal-ceramic crowns?
التفسير: Metal coping can show through thin gingiva, causing a dark line at the margin.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4695): Which margin type provides best esthetic results with all-ceramic crowns?
التفسير: Shoulder margins provide a broad, well-defined margin needed for ceramic thickness and esthetics.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4696): What is the best way to manage gingival inflammation after crown placement?
خيار 1: Improve oral hygiene and remove irritants
الإجابة: Improve oral hygiene and remove irritants
التفسير: Local plaque and margin irritation cause inflammation; hygiene control is key.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4697): Which factor can cause staining of ceramic restorations?
التفسير: Rough surfaces trap stains and plaque leading to discoloration.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4698): Which laboratory error most commonly causes poor fit of fixed restorations?
التفسير: Wax patterns can distort before casting, affecting fit and accuracy.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4699): What is the effect of an overcontoured crown margin on gingiva?
التفسير: Bulky margins prevent cleaning, causing chronic irritation and tissue recession.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4700): Which of the following is NOT a sign of failure in fixed prosthodontics?
التفسير: Minor adjustments are normal; others indicate potential failure.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4701): What causes “black triangle” formation between teeth after prosthesis placement?
التفسير: Poor contouring or bone loss leads to gaps that affect esthetics.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4702): What is the recommended surface treatment for zirconia crowns before cementation?
خيار 1: Sandblasting and use of resin cement with MDP primer
الإجابة: Sandblasting and use of resin cement with MDP primer
التفسير: Sandblasting increases surface roughness and MDP primer improves bonding to zirconia.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4703): Which of the following cements is best suited for high strength all-ceramic restorations?
التفسير: Resin cements provide strong adhesion and support ceramic strength.

Q(1): السؤال: Q(4704): What is the primary challenge when restoring teeth with short clinical crowns?
التفسير: Short clinical crowns provide less axial wall height, reducing retention and resistance. Additional procedures may be needed.
